===== FILE: crates/itak-spec/examples/ngram_acceptance.rs =====
//! N-gram acceptance measurement over recorded text streams: the
//! expectation-setting harness for the real-file run.
//!
//! The synthetic fixture target (the crate's test target) proves
//! the mechanism and the identity property, but its greedy stream
//! is a random-weight model's stream, not text, so its acceptance
//! rates say little about real files. This harness measures the
//! property that actually decides n-gram acceptance on a real
//! model: how much the emitted stream repeats itself. It replays
//! two recorded streams through the proposer in lockstep, under
//! exactly the session's greedy accounting (propose after
//! `pending`, accept the matching prefix, commit
//! `[pending, accepted...]`, emit one correction token), one
//! stream built from a repeated template block and one from
//! varied prose.
//!
//! Tokenization is word-level (each distinct word gets an id in
//! first-appearance order), which overstates repetition versus
//! the real model's subword stream: function words repeat as
//! whole tokens here. Read the rates as directional, with the
//! repetitive-versus-prose gap as the finding; the real-file
//! measurement on Glimmer stays owed and is named in
//! `bench/ngram-spec-2026-11-07.md`.
//!
//! Usage: `cargo run -p itak-spec --example ngram_acceptance -- [depth]`

use itak_spec::{DraftArm, NgramConfig, NgramProposer, Speculator};

/// A templated status block, repeated verbatim: the shape of
/// logs, reports, and boilerplate generation.
const TEMPLATE_BLOCK: &str = "nightly backup completed for volume data one \
    files copied four thousand ninety two bytes written nine hundred twelve \
    megabytes duration forty one seconds status ok next run scheduled at \
    zero two hundred hours retention policy keeps seven daily snapshots and \
    four weekly snapshots verification checksum matched for every file in \
    the volume no errors were recorded during this run";

/// Varied prose: one pass, no repeated sentences.
const PROSE: &str = "the ferry crossed the harbor before sunrise while \
    gulls circled above the empty docks and a cold wind pushed small waves \
    against the pilings below the terminal windows where clerks stamped \
    tickets for passengers carrying baskets of bread fruit and folded \
    newspapers toward the island market and by the time the sun cleared \
    the lighthouse the deckhands had coiled every rope scrubbed the \
    gangway and logged the crossing in a leather book that smelled of \
    diesel and salt although none of them expected anyone ashore to read \
    a single line of it ever again because the office had switched to \
    electronic records years earlier and kept the book only out of habit \
    and a quiet respect for the captains who had filled its earlier pages \
    with careful handwriting during storms that bent the channel markers \
    and drove the smaller boats back into shelter";

/// Map each distinct word to an id in first-appearance order.
fn tokenize(text: &str) -> Vec<u32> {
    let mut vocab: Vec<&str> = Vec::new();
    text.split_whitespace()
        .map(|word| match vocab.iter().position(|&w| w == word) {
            Some(id) => id as u32,
            None => {
                vocab.push(word);
                (vocab.len() - 1) as u32
            }
        })
        .collect()
}

/// Lockstep greedy simulation, the session's accounting replayed
/// at the proposer level (the same simulation the crate's unit
/// tests pin). Returns (rounds, proposed, accepted).
fn simulate(
    stream: &[u32],
    prompt_len: usize,
    depth: usize,
    vocab: usize,
) -> (usize, usize, usize) {
    let mut prop =
        NgramProposer::new(NgramConfig::default(), vocab).expect("default config is valid");
    prop.commit(&stream[..prompt_len]).expect("commit prompt");
    let mut pending = stream[prompt_len];
    let mut pos = prompt_len + 1;
    let (mut rounds, mut proposed, mut accepted_total) = (0usize, 0usize, 0usize);
    let mut no_draws = || 0.0f64;
    while pos < stream.len() {
        rounds += 1;
        let tokens = prop
            .propose_block(pending, depth, DraftArm::Greedy, &mut no_draws)
            .expect("proposal")
            .tokens;
        proposed += tokens.len();
        let mut accepted = 0;
        while accepted < tokens.len()
            && pos + accepted < stream.len()
            && tokens[accepted] == stream[pos + accepted]
        {
            accepted += 1;
        }
        accepted_total += accepted;
        let mut committed = vec![pending];
        committed.extend_from_slice(&stream[pos..pos + accepted]);
        prop.commit(&committed).expect("commit round");
        if pos + accepted >= stream.len() {
            break;
        }
        pending = stream[pos + accepted];
        pos += accepted + 1;
    }
    (rounds, proposed, accepted_total)
}

fn main() {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    let depth: usize = args.get(1).map_or(6, |a| a.parse().unwrap_or(6));

    let mut repetitive_text = String::new();
    for _ in 0..6 {
        repetitive_text.push_str(TEMPLATE_BLOCK);
        repetitive_text.push(' ');
    }
    let repetitive = tokenize(&repetitive_text);
    let prose = tokenize(PROSE);
    let vocab = (repetitive.iter().chain(prose.iter()).max().expect("tokens") + 1) as usize;

    println!("n-gram lockstep acceptance (word-tokenized streams, depth {depth})");
    for (name, stream) in [("repetitive", &repetitive), ("prose", &prose)] {
        let prompt_len = 24.min(stream.len() / 4);
        let (rounds, proposed, accepted) = simulate(stream, prompt_len, depth, vocab);
        let rate = if proposed == 0 {
            0.0
        } else {
            accepted as f64 / proposed as f64
        };
        let tokens_per_round = if rounds == 0 {
            0.0
        } else {
            (stream.len() - prompt_len) as f64 / rounds as f64
        };
        println!(
            "{name}: stream_tokens={} prompt={prompt_len} rounds={rounds} proposed={proposed} \
             accepted={accepted} acceptance_rate={rate:.4} stream_tokens_per_round={tokens_per_round:.3}",
            stream.len()
        );
    }
}

===== END FILE: crates/itak-spec/examples/ngram_acceptance.rs =====

===== FILE: crates/itak-spec/examples/spec_generate.rs =====
//! Real-file proof for the speculative loop (SPEC-itak-spec Sections 4
//! and 9): DFlash drafting against the real Glimmer files on CPU, with
//! the token-identity guarantee checked against a plain greedy run of
//! the same target in the same process.
//!
//! Usage: `spec_generate <target.gguf> <draft.gguf> [n_tokens] [depth] [prompt] [mode] [stream_file] [--drafter=<dflash|ngram>]`
//!
//! `mode` is `both` (default), `plain` (run only phase A and write the
//! stream to `stream_file`), or `spec` (run only phase B, reading the
//! expected stream from `stream_file`). Splitting the phases into two
//! processes halves the peak memory: this runner's first server attempt
//! was OOM-killed with both phases' weight sets resident.
//!
//! `--drafter` selects phase B's draft source (the `SpecMode` name,
//! parsed by `SpecMode::parse`, in the GPU runner's `--draft` style):
//! `dflash` (default) loads the draft file and drafts with the DFlash
//! model; `ngram` never opens the draft file (the positional path is
//! still required; pass any placeholder) and drafts with the n-gram
//! prompt-lookup proposer through `SpecSession::new_ngram`, so the
//! same identity and golden verdicts measure the no-training
//! self-drafting arm on the real file.
//!
//! Phase A runs the plain greedy baseline (prefill plus single-token
//! steps). Phase B runs a [`SpecSession`] at temperature 0 with the
//! draft attached. The streams must be token-identical; the first eight
//! tokens of the default Stage 1 prompt must equal the verified golden
//! continuation. Wall times per token are printed for both routes: on
//! CPU the speculative route is not expected to win (the mechanism is
//! the deliverable; speed belongs to the GPU path), and the numbers are
//! reported as measured either way.
//!
//! This is a correctness runner, not a benchmark: the CPU reference
//! dequantizes as it goes, so both phases are minutes-to-hours class.

use std::io::Write;
use std::path::Path;
use std::process::ExitCode;
use std::rc::Rc;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Instant;

use cpu_compute::CpuCompute;
use dflash::{DflashModel, StderrDiag as DflashStderrDiag, TensorSource as _};
use itak_spec::{
    sampler, DflashSpeculator, NgramConfig, NgramProposer, SharedCompute, SpecConfig, SpecMode,
    SpecSession, StderrDiag,
};
use muse_glimmer::{GlimmerModel, PositionCache};
use tokenizer::{TokenType, Tokenizer, TokenizerData};

/// The verified greedy continuation of the Stage 1 prompt
/// (bench/gpu-proof-2026-10-30.md): " Paris. It is the most populous".
const GOLDEN_FIRST8: [u32; 8] = [13796, 26, 1573, 373, 290, 2167, 26899, 1212];

/// The draft depth when the caller does not pass one: 1, this
/// stack's own measured winner (the T-9.7 sweep,
/// bench/spec-sweep-gpu-fixed-2026-11-04.md), and the default
/// [`SpecConfig`] itself carries. The depth 6 this runner once
/// defaulted to is the llama.cpp operating point, never this
/// stack's pick.
const DEFAULT_DEPTH: usize = 1;

fn main() -> ExitCode {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    let (Some(target_path), Some(draft_path)) = (args.get(1), args.get(2)) else {
        eprintln!("usage: spec_generate <target.gguf> <draft.gguf> [n_tokens] [depth] [prompt]");
        return ExitCode::from(2);
    };
    let n_tokens: usize = args.get(3).map_or(16, |a| a.parse().unwrap_or(16));
    let depth: usize = args
        .get(4)
        .map_or(DEFAULT_DEPTH, |a| a.parse().unwrap_or(DEFAULT_DEPTH));
    let prompt = args
        .get(5)
        .map_or("The capital of France is", String::as_str);
    let mode = args.get(6).map_or("both", String::as_str);
    let stream_file = args
        .get(7)
        .map_or("plain_stream.txt", String::as_str)
        .to_string();
    let drafter = match args.iter().find_map(|a| a.strip_prefix("--drafter=")) {
        Some(text) => match SpecMode::parse(text) {
            Some(m @ (SpecMode::Dflash | SpecMode::Ngram)) => m,
            _ => {
                eprintln!("FAIL: --drafter must be dflash or ngram, got {text:?}");
                return ExitCode::from(2);
            }
        },
        None => SpecMode::Dflash,
    };
    match run(
        target_path,
        draft_path,
        prompt,
        n_tokens,
        depth,
        mode,
        &stream_file,
        drafter,
    ) {
        Ok(true) => ExitCode::SUCCESS,
        Ok(false) => ExitCode::FAILURE,
        Err(msg) => {
            eprintln!("FAIL: {msg}");
            ExitCode::FAILURE
        }
    }
}

fn phase(label: &str, t: Instant) {
    println!("[{label}] {:.1}s", t.elapsed().as_secs_f64());
    let _ = std::io::stdout().flush();
}

/// Same thin tokenizer adapter as the other integration runners.
fn data_from_info(
    info: &gguf::TokenizerInfo,
    model: Option<String>,
    unknown: Option<u32>,
) -> TokenizerData {
    TokenizerData {
        model,
        tokens: info.tokens.clone(),
        token_types: info
            .token_types
            .as_ref()
            .map(|types| types.iter().map(|&t| TokenType::from_gguf(t)).collect())
            .unwrap_or_default(),
        merges: info.merges.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
        scores: info.scores.clone(),
        bos_token_id: info.bos_token_id,
        eos_token_id: info.eos_token_id,
        unknown_token_id: unknown,
        padding_token_id: info.padding_token_id,
    }
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn run(
    target_path: &str,
    draft_path: &str,
    prompt: &str,
    n_tokens: usize,
    depth: usize,
    mode: &str,
    stream_file: &str,
    drafter: SpecMode,
) -> Result<bool, String> {
    let total = Instant::now();

    // Load the target; the draft file loads only on the dflash arm
    // (coverage gate enforced there). The n-gram arm has no draft
    // model to load: its proposer is built from configuration at
    // phase B.
    let t = Instant::now();
    let target_file = gguf::GgufFile::open(Path::new(target_path)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let gcfg = itak_loader::load_config(&target_file).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let draft = if drafter == SpecMode::Ngram {
        println!(
            "draft: ngram prompt-lookup (draft file {draft_path} not loaded) | \
             target: layers={} hidden={} vocab={}",
            gcfg.block_count, gcfg.hidden, gcfg.vocab_size
        );
        None
    } else {
        let draft_file = gguf::GgufFile::open(Path::new(draft_path)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let dcfg = itak_loader::load_dflash_config(&draft_file).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let report = itak_loader::coverage_dflash(&draft_file, &dcfg);
        println!(
            "draft coverage: expected={} found={} missing={}",
            report.expected_count(),
            report.found_count(),
            report.missing().len()
        );
        report.require_complete().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let dweights =
            itak_loader::load_dflash_weights(&draft_file, &dcfg).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        println!(
            "draft: block_size={} target_layers={:?} mask={} | target: layers={} hidden={} vocab={}",
            dcfg.block_size,
            dcfg.target_layers,
            dcfg.mask_token_id,
            gcfg.block_count,
            gcfg.hidden,
            gcfg.vocab_size
        );
        // The draft runs with its diagnostic sink attached (the
        // dflash channel's own StderrDiag, aliased: the session below
        // takes itak_spec's), so the draft's refusals and passes are
        // as observable as the session's.
        Some(DflashModel::with_diag(
            dcfg.clone(),
            dweights,
            Arc::new(DflashStderrDiag),
        ))
    };

    let info = target_file.tokenizer().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let tok_model = target_file
        .metadata()
        .opt_string("tokenizer.ggml.model")
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        .map(str::to_string);
    let tokenizer =
        Tokenizer::new(data_from_info(&info, tok_model, None)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut prompt_ids = tokenizer.encode(prompt).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let add_bos = target_file
        .metadata()
        .get_bool("tokenizer.ggml.add_bos_token")
        .unwrap_or(false);
    if add_bos {
        if let Some(bos) = info.bos_token_id {
            prompt_ids.insert(0, bos);
        }
    }
    println!("prompt {prompt:?} -> ids {prompt_ids:?}");
    let eos: Vec<u32> = info.eos_token_id.into_iter().collect();
    phase("load models + tokenizer", t);

    // ---- Phase A: plain greedy baseline (skipped in spec-only mode,
    // where the expected stream is read from the stream file).
    let t = Instant::now();
    let plain_stream = if mode == "spec" {
        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(stream_file).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let ids: Vec<u32> = text
            .split_whitespace()
            .map(|w| {
                w.parse()
                    .map_err(|_| format!("bad token id {w:?} in {stream_file}"))
            })
            .collect::<Result<_, _>>()?;
        println!("expected stream read from {stream_file}: {ids:?}");
        ids
    } else {
        let gweights = itak_loader::load_weights(&target_file, &gcfg).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let stream = {
            let target = GlimmerModel::new(gcfg.clone(), gweights, Box::new(CpuCompute::new()));
            let mut cache = PositionCache::new();
            let tp = Instant::now();
            let mut logits = target
                .forward(&prompt_ids, &mut cache)
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            println!("plain prefill: {:.1}s", tp.elapsed().as_secs_f64());
            let _ = std::io::stdout().flush();
            let td = Instant::now();
            let mut stream = Vec::with_capacity(n_tokens);
            for i in 0..n_tokens {
                let token = sampler::argmax(&logits);
                stream.push(token);
                if eos.contains(&token) {
                    println!("plain: EOS at generated position {i}");
                    break;
                }
                if i + 1 < n_tokens {
                    logits = target
                        .forward(&[token], &mut cache)
                        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                }
            }
            let decode_s = td.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
            println!(
                "plain stream: {stream:?} ({:.1}s decode, {:.2}s/token after prefill)",
                decode_s,
                decode_s / stream.len().max(1) as f64
            );
            stream
        };
        let text: String = stream.iter().map(|id| format!("{id} ")).collect();
        std::fs::write(stream_file, text).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        println!("plain stream written to {stream_file}");
        stream
    };
    let plain_wall = t.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
    phase("phase A plain greedy", t);
    if mode == "plain" {
        println!("PLAIN ONLY: phase B skipped by mode");
        phase("total", total);
        return Ok(true);
    }

    // ---- Phase B: speculative session, temperature 0.
    let t = Instant::now();
    let gweights = itak_loader::load_weights(&target_file, &gcfg).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let compute = Rc::new(CpuCompute::new());
    let target = GlimmerModel::new(
        gcfg.clone(),
        gweights,
        Box::new(SharedCompute(compute.clone())),
    );
    let driver = itak_spec::CpuTarget::new(target, compute);
    let (mut session, prefill_kind) = match drafter {
        SpecMode::Ngram => {
            let proposer = NgramProposer::new(NgramConfig::default(), gcfg.vocab_size as usize)
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            let config = SpecConfig {
                mode: SpecMode::Ngram,
                depth,
                eos_tokens: eos,
                ..SpecConfig::default()
            };
            let session =
                SpecSession::new_ngram(driver, Some(proposer), config, Arc::new(StderrDiag))
                    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            (session, "plain + proposer commit")
        }
        _ => {
            let source = itak_loader::DflashTensorSource::new(&target_file);
            let embedding = source
                .tensor("token_embd.weight")
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            let output_head = source.tensor("output.weight").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            let speculator = DflashSpeculator::new(
                draft.expect("dflash arm loaded the draft"),
                embedding,
                output_head,
            );
            let config = SpecConfig {
                depth,
                eos_tokens: eos,
                ..SpecConfig::default()
            };
            let session = SpecSession::new(driver, Some(speculator), config, Arc::new(StderrDiag))
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            (session, "capturing")
        }
    };
    let tp = Instant::now();
    let pending = session.begin(&prompt_ids).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    println!(
        "spec prefill ({prefill_kind}): {:.1}s, pending={pending}",
        tp.elapsed().as_secs_f64()
    );
    let _ = std::io::stdout().flush();
    let spec_stream = session.generate(n_tokens, &[]).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let stats = session.finish();
    let spec_wall = t.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
    println!("spec stream: {spec_stream:?}");
    println!(
        "spec stats: rounds={} proposed={} accepted={} acceptance_rate={:.3} \
         rejections={} rollbacks={} tokens_per_round={:.2} fallback_latched={}",
        stats.rounds,
        stats.proposed,
        stats.accepted,
        stats.acceptance_rate(),
        stats.rejections,
        stats.rollbacks,
        stats.tokens_per_round(),
        stats.fallback_latched
    );
    println!(
        "wall: plain {:.1}s total ({:.2}s/token), spec {:.1}s total ({:.2}s/token)",
        plain_wall,
        plain_wall / plain_stream.len().max(1) as f64,
        spec_wall,
        spec_wall / spec_stream.len().max(1) as f64
    );
    phase("phase B speculative", t);

    // ---- The verdict.
    let mut ok = true;
    if spec_stream == plain_stream {
        println!(
            "IDENTITY: PASS ({} tokens token-identical to plain greedy)",
            spec_stream.len()
        );
    } else {
        ok = false;
        println!("IDENTITY: FAIL");
        println!("  plain: {plain_stream:?}");
        println!("  spec:  {spec_stream:?}");
        for (i, (a, b)) in plain_stream.iter().zip(spec_stream.iter()).enumerate() {
            if a != b {
                println!("  first divergence at generated position {i}: plain {a} vs spec {b}");
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if prompt == "The capital of France is" && spec_stream.len() >= 8 {
        if spec_stream[..8] == GOLDEN_FIRST8 {
            println!("GOLDEN: PASS (first 8 match the verified continuation)");
        } else {
            ok = false;
            println!(
                "GOLDEN: FAIL (first 8 are {:?}, expected {GOLDEN_FIRST8:?})",
                &spec_stream[..8]
            );
        }
    }
    phase("total", total);
    Ok(ok)
}

===== END FILE: crates/itak-spec/examples/spec_generate.rs =====

===== FILE: crates/itak-spec/examples/spec_generate_gpu.rs =====
//! Real-file proof for the speculative loop on the GPU-resident
//! stack (TODO T-9.6): DFlash drafting against the real Glimmer
//! files with the target verifying on `wgpu-compute`'s resident
//! session, checked against a plain greedy run of the same
//! resident session in the same process.
//!
//! Usage: `spec_generate_gpu <target.gguf> <draft.gguf> [n_tokens] [depth] [prompt] [mode] [stream_file] [--bar=<tok/s>] [--draft=<gpu|cpu>] [--drafter=<dflash|ngram>] [--kv-capacity=<positions>]`
//!
//! `mode` is `both` (default), `plain` (run only phase A and write
//! the stream to `stream_file`), or `spec` (run only phase B,
//! reading the expected stream from `stream_file`). The phases
//! are separate scopes (and can be separate processes) for the
//! reason the CPU runner splits them: each phase's weight set
//! drops before the next builds.
//!
//! Phase A runs the plain greedy baseline on the resident
//! session (prefill plus single-token forwards). Phase B runs a
//! [`SpecSession`] over the resident driver at temperature 0 with
//! the DFlash draft attached. The draft's device path is the
//! `--draft` selection (a [`SpecConfig`] field with the library
//! default CPU): `gpu` (this runner's default, since the runner
//! exists to prove the GPU stack) drives wgpu-compute's resident
//! draft session on the same leaked backend as the target's
//! resident session; `cpu` drives the reference implementation
//! behind the same `Speculator` seam, for A/B runs. The verify
//! side is the resident GPU forward throughout. See
//! `bench/dflash-gpu-2026-11-03.md` for the draft GPU design.
//!
//! `--drafter` selects phase B's draft source (the `SpecMode`
//! name, parsed by `SpecMode::parse`, in the CPU runner
//! `spec_generate`'s style): `dflash` (default) loads the draft
//! file and drafts with the DFlash model on the `--draft`
//! device path; `ngram` never opens the draft file (the
//! positional path is still required; pass any placeholder)
//! and drafts with the n-gram prompt-lookup proposer through
//! `SpecSession::new_ngram` over the same resident target, so
//! the same IDENTITY, GOLDEN, and SPEED verdicts and the same
//! round accounting measure the no-training self-drafting arm
//! against the DFlash arms. `--draft` and `--kv-capacity`
//! configure the DFlash arm only; in ngram mode they are still
//! parsed and validated by name, and the run prints that they
//! do not apply.
//!
//! The T-9.6 bar, printed as verdicts: the speculative stream is
//! token-identical to the plain GPU stream at temperature 0
//! (IDENTITY), the default prompt's first eight tokens match
//! the verified golden continuation (GOLDEN), and the effective
//! speculative rate (tokens emitted during `generate`, divided
//! by its wall time) reaches the recorded llama-server
//! speculative baseline (SPEED; `--bar` overrides the 88.6
//! default for sweeps, TODO T-9.7). The process exit code
//! follows the correctness contract (identity and golden), the
//! CPU runner's convention; the SPEED verdict and the combined
//! T-9.6 line print either way, so a speed miss is never
//! mistaken for a correctness miss or vice versa.
//!
//! Server run (the GPU must be free; the resident session takes
//! the card):
//! `cargo run --release -p itak-spec --example spec_generate_gpu -- /mnt/models/Muse-Glimmer-30B/Muse-Glimmer-30B-KQuant-17GB-Q4_K_M.gguf /mnt/models/Muse-Glimmer-30B/dflash-Muse-Glimmer-30B-Q4_K_M.gguf 64 6`
//!
//! The n-gram arm needs no draft file (any placeholder stands
//! in the positional slot):
//! `cargo run --release -p itak-spec --example spec_generate_gpu -- /mnt/models/Muse-Glimmer-30B/Muse-Glimmer-30B-KQuant-17GB-Q4_K_M.gguf unused.gguf 64 6 "The capital of France is" both plain_stream.txt --drafter=ngram`

use std::io::Write;
use std::path::Path;
use std::process::ExitCode;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Instant;

use dflash::{DflashModel, StderrDiag as DflashStderrDiag, TensorSource as _};
use itak_spec::{
    sampler, DflashSpeculator, DraftBackend, NgramConfig, NgramProposer, ResidentTarget,
    SpecConfig, SpecMode, SpecSession, StderrDiag,
};
use muse_glimmer::TensorSource as GlimmerTensorSource;
use tokenizer::{TokenType, Tokenizer, TokenizerData};
use wgpu_compute::{
    DflashRawWeights, DflashSession, DflashSessionConfig, ResidentSession, WgpuCompute,
};

/// The verified greedy continuation of the Stage 1 prompt
/// (bench/gpu-proof-2026-10-30.md): " Paris. It is the most populous".
const GOLDEN_FIRST8: [u32; 8] = [13796, 26, 1573, 373, 290, 2167, 26899, 1212];

/// The T-9.6 speed bar: the recorded llama-server DFlash
/// operating point (107.39 tok/s at depth 6 in the sweep; the
/// TODO item states the bar as the 88.6 baseline figure).
/// An acceptance threshold for this proof, not an operational
/// limit; `--bar` overrides it.
const DEFAULT_BAR_TOK_S: f64 = 88.6;

/// The draft depth when the caller does not pass one: 1, this
/// stack's own measured winner (the T-9.7 sweep,
/// bench/spec-sweep-gpu-fixed-2026-11-04.md), and the default
/// `SpecConfig` itself carries. The depth 6 this runner once
/// defaulted to is the llama.cpp operating point (the bar
/// above is measured at it), never this stack's pick.
const DEFAULT_DEPTH: usize = 1;

fn main() -> ExitCode {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    let (Some(target_path), Some(draft_path)) = (args.get(1), args.get(2)) else {
        eprintln!(
            "usage: spec_generate_gpu <target.gguf> <draft.gguf> [n_tokens] [depth] [prompt] \
             [mode] [stream_file] [--bar=<tok/s>] [--drafter=<dflash|ngram>]"
        );
        return ExitCode::from(2);
    };
    let n_tokens: usize = args.get(3).map_or(64, |a| a.parse().unwrap_or(64));
    let depth: usize = args
        .get(4)
        .map_or(DEFAULT_DEPTH, |a| a.parse().unwrap_or(DEFAULT_DEPTH));
    let prompt = args
        .get(5)
        .map_or("The capital of France is", String::as_str);
    let mode = args.get(6).map_or("both", String::as_str);
    let stream_file = args
        .get(7)
        .map_or("plain_stream.txt", String::as_str)
        .to_string();
    let bar: f64 = args
        .iter()
        .find_map(|a| a.strip_prefix("--bar="))
        .map_or(DEFAULT_BAR_TOK_S, |v| {
            v.parse().unwrap_or(DEFAULT_BAR_TOK_S)
        });
    // The draft device path: config with a default (gpu on
    // this runner), never a compiled constant. An unknown
    // value refuses by name instead of guessing.
    let draft_backend = match args.iter().find_map(|a| a.strip_prefix("--draft=")) {
        None => DraftBackend::Gpu,
        Some(text) => match DraftBackend::parse(text) {
            Some(parsed) => parsed,
            None => {
                eprintln!("FAIL: --draft={text} is not a draft backend (expected gpu or cpu)");
                return ExitCode::from(2);
            }
        },
    };
    // The draft source: the CPU runner's `--drafter` flag,
    // parsed by the shared `SpecMode::parse` (no second
    // parser). An unknown or unimplemented value refuses by
    // name before any model loads.
    let drafter = match args.iter().find_map(|a| a.strip_prefix("--drafter=")) {
        Some(text) => match SpecMode::parse(text) {
            Some(m @ (SpecMode::Dflash | SpecMode::Ngram)) => m,
            _ => {
                eprintln!("FAIL: --drafter must be dflash or ngram, got {text:?}");
                return ExitCode::from(2);
            }
        },
        None => SpecMode::Dflash,
    };
    // The GPU draft's resident KV capacity, in positions:
    // session config with the DflashSessionConfig default,
    // raised here for runs whose committed length outgrows
    // it (an injection past capacity refuses by name).
    let kv_capacity: usize = args
        .iter()
        .find_map(|a| a.strip_prefix("--kv-capacity="))
        .map_or(DflashSessionConfig::default().kv_capacity, |v| {
            v.parse()
                .unwrap_or(DflashSessionConfig::default().kv_capacity)
        });
    match run(
        target_path,
        draft_path,
        prompt,
        n_tokens,
        depth,
        mode,
        &stream_file,
        bar,
        draft_backend,
        drafter,
        kv_capacity,
    ) {
        Ok(true) => ExitCode::SUCCESS,
        Ok(false) => ExitCode::FAILURE,
        Err(msg) => {
            eprintln!("FAIL: {msg}");
            ExitCode::FAILURE
        }
    }
}

fn phase(label: &str, t: Instant) {
    println!("[{label}] {:.1}s", t.elapsed().as_secs_f64());
    let _ = std::io::stdout().flush();
}

/// Same thin tokenizer adapter as the other integration runners.
fn data_from_info(
    info: &gguf::TokenizerInfo,
    model: Option<String>,
    unknown: Option<u32>,
) -> TokenizerData {
    TokenizerData {
        model,
        tokens: info.tokens.clone(),
        token_types: info
            .token_types
            .as_ref()
            .map(|types| types.iter().map(|&t| TokenType::from_gguf(t)).collect())
            .unwrap_or_default(),
        merges: info.merges.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
        scores: info.scores.clone(),
        bos_token_id: info.bos_token_id,
        eos_token_id: info.eos_token_id,
        unknown_token_id: unknown,
        padding_token_id: info.padding_token_id,
    }
}

/// One phase's resident session over freshly loaded weights.
/// The session borrows its backend, so the backend handle is
/// leaked deliberately: process-lifetime, one per phase, the
/// runner's own memory discipline (the weights and device
/// state drop with the session at the caller's scope end; the
/// leaked handle is one small allocation per phase).
fn resident_session(
    target_file: &gguf::GgufFile,
    gcfg: &muse_glimmer::GlimmerConfig,
) -> Result<ResidentSession<'static>, String> {
    let backend: &'static WgpuCompute =
        Box::leak(Box::new(WgpuCompute::new().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?));
    resident_session_on(backend, target_file, gcfg)
}

/// A resident session over a caller-supplied backend: phase
/// B shares one leaked backend between the target's resident
/// session and the draft's, so both device residents live on
/// the same device and queue.
fn resident_session_on(
    backend: &'static WgpuCompute,
    target_file: &gguf::GgufFile,
    gcfg: &muse_glimmer::GlimmerConfig,
) -> Result<ResidentSession<'static>, String> {
    let report = itak_loader::coverage(target_file, gcfg);
    println!(
        "target coverage: expected={} found={} missing={}",
        report.expected_count(),
        report.found_count(),
        report.missing().len()
    );
    report.require_complete().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let weights = itak_loader::load_weights(target_file, gcfg).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    ResidentSession::new(backend, gcfg, &weights).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn run(
    target_path: &str,
    draft_path: &str,
    prompt: &str,
    n_tokens: usize,
    depth: usize,
    mode: &str,
    stream_file: &str,
    bar: f64,
    draft_backend: DraftBackend,
    drafter: SpecMode,
    kv_capacity: usize,
) -> Result<bool, String> {
    let total = Instant::now();

    // Load the draft config (coverage gate enforced, dflash
    // arm only) and the target config. The draft WEIGHTS load
    // inside phase B, in the selected arm's own form (f32 for
    // the CPU arm, raw views for the GPU arm), so a GPU run
    // never pays the CPU dequantization and a CPU run never
    // uploads. The n-gram arm never opens the draft file, the
    // CPU runner's precedent: the positional path is still
    // required by the usage line (pass any placeholder), and
    // the run says out loud that the file is not loaded and
    // that `--draft` / `--kv-capacity` do not apply to it.
    let t = Instant::now();
    let (draft_file, dcfg) = if drafter == SpecMode::Ngram {
        println!(
            "drafter: ngram prompt-lookup (draft file {draft_path} not loaded; \
             --draft and --kv-capacity configure the dflash arm only)"
        );
        (None, None)
    } else {
        let draft_file = gguf::GgufFile::open(Path::new(draft_path)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let dcfg = itak_loader::load_dflash_config(&draft_file).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let report = itak_loader::coverage_dflash(&draft_file, &dcfg);
        println!(
            "draft coverage: expected={} found={} missing={}",
            report.expected_count(),
            report.found_count(),
            report.missing().len()
        );
        report.require_complete().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        (Some(draft_file), Some(dcfg))
    };

    let target_file = gguf::GgufFile::open(Path::new(target_path)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let gcfg = itak_loader::load_config(&target_file).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    if let Some(dcfg) = &dcfg {
        println!(
            "draft: block_size={} target_layers={:?} mask={} | target: layers={} hidden={} vocab={}",
            dcfg.block_size,
            dcfg.target_layers,
            dcfg.mask_token_id,
            gcfg.block_count,
            gcfg.hidden,
            gcfg.vocab_size
        );
    } else {
        println!(
            "drafter: ngram prompt-lookup | target: layers={} hidden={} vocab={}",
            gcfg.block_count, gcfg.hidden, gcfg.vocab_size
        );
    }

    let info = target_file.tokenizer().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let tok_model = target_file
        .metadata()
        .opt_string("tokenizer.ggml.model")
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        .map(str::to_string);
    let tokenizer =
        Tokenizer::new(data_from_info(&info, tok_model, None)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut prompt_ids = tokenizer.encode(prompt).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let add_bos = target_file
        .metadata()
        .get_bool("tokenizer.ggml.add_bos_token")
        .unwrap_or(false);
    if add_bos {
        if let Some(bos) = info.bos_token_id {
            prompt_ids.insert(0, bos);
        }
    }
    println!("prompt {prompt:?} -> ids {prompt_ids:?}");
    let eos: Vec<u32> = info.eos_token_id.into_iter().collect();
    phase(
        if drafter == SpecMode::Ngram {
            "load target + tokenizer"
        } else {
            "load draft + tokenizer"
        },
        t,
    );

    // ---- Phase A: plain greedy on the resident session (skipped in
    // spec-only mode, where the expected stream is read from the
    // stream file).
    let t = Instant::now();
    let plain_stream = if mode == "spec" {
        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(stream_file).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let ids: Vec<u32> = text
            .split_whitespace()
            .map(|w| {
                w.parse()
                    .map_err(|_| format!("bad token id {w:?} in {stream_file}"))
            })
            .collect::<Result<_, _>>()?;
        println!("expected stream read from {stream_file}: {ids:?}");
        ids
    } else {
        let mut session = resident_session(&target_file, &gcfg)?;
        let tp = Instant::now();
        let mut logits = session.forward(&prompt_ids).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let prefill_s = tp.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
        println!("plain prefill (resident): {prefill_s:.3}s");
        let _ = std::io::stdout().flush();
        let td = Instant::now();
        let mut stream = Vec::with_capacity(n_tokens);
        for i in 0..n_tokens {
            let token = sampler::argmax(&logits);
            stream.push(token);
            if eos.contains(&token) {
                println!("plain: EOS at generated position {i}");
                break;
            }
            if i + 1 < n_tokens {
                logits = session.forward(&[token]).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            }
        }
        let decode_s = td.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
        let stats = session.stats();
        println!(
            "plain stream: {stream:?} ({:.2} tok/s decode, {} chunks, {} submissions, \
             {} dispatches)",
            stream.len() as f64 / decode_s.max(f64::MIN_POSITIVE),
            stats.chunks,
            stats.submissions,
            stats.dispatches
        );
        let text: String = stream.iter().map(|id| format!("{id} ")).collect();
        std::fs::write(stream_file, text).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        println!("plain stream written to {stream_file}");
        stream
    };
    let plain_wall = t.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
    phase("phase A plain greedy (resident)", t);
    if mode == "plain" {
        println!("PLAIN ONLY: phase B skipped by mode");
        phase("total", total);
        return Ok(true);
    }

    // ---- Phase B: the speculative session over the resident driver,
    // temperature 0. The dflash arm drafts with the DFlash model on
    // the selected device path behind the Speculator seam; the
    // n-gram arm drafts with the prompt-lookup proposer through
    // `SpecSession::new_ngram` over the same resident target, with
    // no draft model built at all.
    let t = Instant::now();
    let spec_stream = {
        // One leaked backend serves both residents (the
        // runner's memory discipline, as in phase A).
        let backend: &'static WgpuCompute =
            Box::leak(Box::new(WgpuCompute::new().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?));
        let session = resident_session_on(backend, &target_file, &gcfg)?;
        let (mut session, prefill_kind) = match drafter {
            SpecMode::Ngram => {
                let proposer = NgramProposer::new(NgramConfig::default(), gcfg.vocab_size as usize)
                    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                let config = SpecConfig {
                    mode: SpecMode::Ngram,
                    depth,
                    eos_tokens: eos,
                    ..SpecConfig::default()
                };
                println!("drafter: ngram prompt-lookup (default proposer config)");
                let session = SpecSession::new_ngram(
                    ResidentTarget::new(session),
                    Some(proposer),
                    config,
                    Arc::new(StderrDiag),
                )
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                (session, "plain + proposer commit")
            }
            _ => {
                let draft_file = draft_file
                    .as_ref()
                    .expect("the dflash arm loaded the draft file");
                let dcfg = dcfg
                    .as_ref()
                    .expect("the dflash arm loaded the draft config");
                let speculator = match draft_backend {
                    DraftBackend::Cpu => {
                        let dweights = itak_loader::load_dflash_weights(draft_file, dcfg)
                            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                        let draft = DflashModel::with_diag(
                            dcfg.clone(),
                            dweights,
                            Arc::new(DflashStderrDiag),
                        );
                        let source = itak_loader::DflashTensorSource::new(&target_file);
                        let embedding = source
                            .tensor("token_embd.weight")
                            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                        let output_head =
                            source.tensor("output.weight").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                        println!("draft backend: cpu (reference implementation)");
                        DflashSpeculator::new(draft, embedding, output_head)
                    }
                    DraftBackend::Gpu => {
                        let draft_source = itak_loader::GgufTensorSource::new(draft_file);
                        let raw = DflashRawWeights::load(&draft_source, dcfg)
                            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                        let target_source = itak_loader::GgufTensorSource::new(&target_file);
                        let embedding =
                            GlimmerTensorSource::tensor(&target_source, "token_embd.weight")
                                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                        let output_head =
                            GlimmerTensorSource::tensor(&target_source, "output.weight")
                                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                        let draft_session = DflashSession::with_diag(
                            backend,
                            dcfg,
                            &raw,
                            Some(&embedding),
                            Some(&output_head),
                            DflashSessionConfig { kv_capacity },
                            Arc::new(DflashStderrDiag),
                        )
                        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                        println!(
                            "draft backend: gpu (resident draft session, \
                             kv_capacity={kv_capacity})"
                        );
                        DflashSpeculator::gpu(draft_session)
                    }
                };
                let config = SpecConfig {
                    depth,
                    draft_backend,
                    eos_tokens: eos,
                    ..SpecConfig::default()
                };
                let session = SpecSession::new(
                    ResidentTarget::new(session),
                    Some(speculator),
                    config,
                    Arc::new(StderrDiag),
                )
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                (session, "capturing")
            }
        };
        let tp = Instant::now();
        let pending = session.begin(&prompt_ids).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let prefill_s = tp.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
        println!("spec prefill (resident, {prefill_kind}): {prefill_s:.3}s, pending={pending}");
        let _ = std::io::stdout().flush();
        let tg = Instant::now();
        let stream = session.generate(n_tokens, &[]).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let generate_s = tg.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
        let resident_stats = session.driver().session().stats();
        let stats = session.finish();
        // Effective rate: tokens the generate phase emitted past
        // the prefill's pending token, over the generate wall.
        let effective = (stream.len() - 1) as f64 / generate_s.max(f64::MIN_POSITIVE);
        let all_in = stream.len() as f64 / (prefill_s + generate_s).max(f64::MIN_POSITIVE);
        println!("spec stream: {stream:?}");
        println!(
            "spec stats: rounds={} proposed={} accepted={} acceptance_rate={:.3} \
             rejections={} rollbacks={} tokens_per_round={:.2} fallback_latched={}",
            stats.rounds,
            stats.proposed,
            stats.accepted,
            stats.acceptance_rate(),
            stats.rejections,
            stats.rollbacks,
            stats.tokens_per_round(),
            stats.fallback_latched
        );
        println!(
            "spec resident counters: forwards={} chunks={} submissions={} readbacks={} \
             dispatches={}",
            resident_stats.forwards,
            resident_stats.chunks,
            resident_stats.submissions,
            resident_stats.readbacks,
            resident_stats.dispatches
        );
        println!(
            "spec rates: effective {effective:.2} tok/s (generate phase), all-in {all_in:.2} \
             tok/s (prefill + generate)"
        );
        (stream, effective)
    };
    let (spec_stream, effective_tok_s) = spec_stream;
    let spec_wall = t.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
    println!(
        "wall: plain {plain_wall:.1}s total, spec {spec_wall:.1}s total (phase walls include \
         weight load and session build)"
    );
    phase("phase B speculative (resident)", t);

    // ---- The verdicts.
    let mut ok = true;
    let identity = spec_stream == plain_stream;
    if identity {
        println!(
            "IDENTITY: PASS ({} tokens token-identical to plain GPU greedy)",
            spec_stream.len()
        );
    } else {
        ok = false;
        println!("IDENTITY: FAIL");
        println!("  plain: {plain_stream:?}");
        println!("  spec:  {spec_stream:?}");
        for (i, (a, b)) in plain_stream.iter().zip(spec_stream.iter()).enumerate() {
            if a != b {
                println!("  first divergence at generated position {i}: plain {a} vs spec {b}");
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    let mut golden = true;
    if prompt == "The capital of France is" && spec_stream.len() >= 8 {
        if spec_stream[..8] == GOLDEN_FIRST8 {
            println!("GOLDEN: PASS (first 8 match the verified continuation)");
        } else {
            golden = false;
            ok = false;
            println!(
                "GOLDEN: FAIL (first 8 are {:?}, expected {GOLDEN_FIRST8:?})",
                &spec_stream[..8]
            );
        }
    }
    let speed = effective_tok_s >= bar;
    if speed {
        println!("SPEED: PASS (effective {effective_tok_s:.2} tok/s >= bar {bar:.1})");
    } else {
        println!("SPEED: FAIL (effective {effective_tok_s:.2} tok/s < bar {bar:.1})");
    }
    println!(
        "T-9.6: {}",
        if identity && golden && speed {
            "PASS (identity, golden, and speed bars all met)"
        } else if identity && golden {
            "CORRECTNESS PASS, SPEED FAIL (see the SPEED line above and \
             bench/dflash-gpu-2026-11-03.md)"
        } else {
            "FAIL (correctness bar missed; see the verdicts above)"
        }
    );
    phase("total", total);
    Ok(ok)
}

===== END FILE: crates/itak-spec/examples/spec_generate_gpu.rs =====

===== FILE: crates/itak-spec/examples/spec_sweep.rs =====
//! Depth and acceptance sweep for the speculative loop (TODO T-9.7):
//! run the loop once per candidate draft depth against the real
//! Glimmer files, log acceptance per depth, and print the one sweep
//! table the bench note files, ending with the chosen default depth.
//!
//! Usage: `spec_sweep <target.gguf> <draft.gguf> [depths] [n_tokens] [prompt]`
//!
//! `depths` is a comma-separated candidate list (`1,2,4,6`) or the
//! word `default` for the configured candidate set
//! ([`SweepConfig::default`]); `n_tokens` is the per-depth generation
//! budget (default: the configured budget, 128); `prompt` defaults to
//! the Stage 1 prompt. Temperature is the session default (0, greedy):
//! acceptance is a property of the draft and the depth, and at
//! temperature 0 every depth's stream is token-identical anyway (the
//! loop's standing proof, filed in bench/spec-loop-2026-10-30.md).
//!
//! The runner is the library's [`run_sweep`] with a CPU factory: each
//! depth reloads both models, builds a fresh [`SpecSession`], and
//! drops it before the next depth loads, so peak memory is one depth's
//! footprint, not the sweep's. Loads and prefill sit outside the
//! measured wall (the sweep times `generate` only). When the GPU
//! loop lands, its lane wires the same `run_sweep` to a GPU factory
//! and this file's table code does not change.
//!
//! On the CPU reference backend the speculative route is not expected
//! to win (a block-forward row costs roughly 5.5x a single-token step
//! here; see the loop proof note): the sweep's CPU numbers measure
//! acceptance honestly and speed truthfully, and the speed case is
//! re-measured on the GPU path with this same runner.

use std::io::Write;
use std::path::Path;
use std::process::ExitCode;
use std::rc::Rc;
use std::sync::Arc;

use cpu_compute::CpuCompute;
use dflash::{DflashModel, StderrDiag as DflashStderrDiag, TensorSource as _};
use itak_spec::{
    run_sweep, CpuTarget, DflashSpeculator, SharedCompute, SpecConfig, SpecSession, StderrDiag,
    SweepConfig,
};
use muse_glimmer::GlimmerModel;
use tokenizer::{TokenType, Tokenizer, TokenizerData};

fn main() -> ExitCode {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    let (Some(target_path), Some(draft_path)) = (args.get(1), args.get(2)) else {
        eprintln!(
            "usage: spec_sweep <target.gguf> <draft.gguf> [depths|default] [n_tokens] [prompt]"
        );
        return ExitCode::from(2);
    };
    let default_sweep = SweepConfig::default();
    let depths = match args.get(3).map(String::as_str) {
        None | Some("default") => default_sweep.depths.clone(),
        Some(text) => match SweepConfig::parse_depths(text) {
            Ok(depths) => depths,
            Err(err) => {
                eprintln!("FAIL: {err}");
                return ExitCode::from(2);
            }
        },
    };
    let n_tokens: usize = args.get(4).map_or(default_sweep.tokens_per_depth, |a| {
        a.parse().unwrap_or(default_sweep.tokens_per_depth)
    });
    let prompt = args
        .get(5)
        .map_or("The capital of France is", String::as_str);
    match run(target_path, draft_path, prompt, depths, n_tokens) {
        Ok(()) => ExitCode::SUCCESS,
        Err(msg) => {
            eprintln!("FAIL: {msg}");
            ExitCode::FAILURE
        }
    }
}

/// Same thin tokenizer adapter as the other integration runners.
fn data_from_info(
    info: &gguf::TokenizerInfo,
    model: Option<String>,
    unknown: Option<u32>,
) -> TokenizerData {
    TokenizerData {
        model,
        tokens: info.tokens.clone(),
        token_types: info
            .token_types
            .as_ref()
            .map(|types| types.iter().map(|&t| TokenType::from_gguf(t)).collect())
            .unwrap_or_default(),
        merges: info.merges.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
        scores: info.scores.clone(),
        bos_token_id: info.bos_token_id,
        eos_token_id: info.eos_token_id,
        unknown_token_id: unknown,
        padding_token_id: info.padding_token_id,
    }
}

/// Build one depth's session over the CPU reference backend: the
/// factory [`run_sweep`] calls per depth. Every load failure is text
/// here (the sweep wraps it with the depth it stopped at); session
/// creation refusals surface through the same channel once built.
fn build_session(
    target_path: &str,
    draft_path: &str,
    eos: &[u32],
    config: &SpecConfig,
) -> Result<SpecSession, String> {
    let draft_file = gguf::GgufFile::open(Path::new(draft_path)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let dcfg = itak_loader::load_dflash_config(&draft_file).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let report = itak_loader::coverage_dflash(&draft_file, &dcfg);
    report.require_complete().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let dweights =
        itak_loader::load_dflash_weights(&draft_file, &dcfg).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let draft = DflashModel::with_diag(dcfg, dweights, Arc::new(DflashStderrDiag));

    let target_file = gguf::GgufFile::open(Path::new(target_path)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let gcfg = itak_loader::load_config(&target_file).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let source = itak_loader::DflashTensorSource::new(&target_file);
    let embedding = source
        .tensor("token_embd.weight")
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let output_head = source.tensor("output.weight").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let gweights = itak_loader::load_weights(&target_file, &gcfg).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let compute = Rc::new(CpuCompute::new());
    let target = GlimmerModel::new(gcfg, gweights, Box::new(SharedCompute(compute.clone())));
    let speculator = DflashSpeculator::new(draft, embedding, output_head);
    let mut config = config.clone();
    config.eos_tokens = eos.to_vec();
    SpecSession::new(
        CpuTarget::new(target, compute),
        Some(speculator),
        config,
        Arc::new(StderrDiag),
    )
    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

fn run(
    target_path: &str,
    draft_path: &str,
    prompt: &str,
    depths: Vec<usize>,
    n_tokens: usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    // Tokenize once: the header read is cheap, and every depth must
    // see the identical prompt and stop set.
    let target_file = gguf::GgufFile::open(Path::new(target_path)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let info = target_file.tokenizer().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let tok_model = target_file
        .metadata()
        .opt_string("tokenizer.ggml.model")
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        .map(str::to_string);
    let tokenizer =
        Tokenizer::new(data_from_info(&info, tok_model, None)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut prompt_ids = tokenizer.encode(prompt).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let add_bos = target_file
        .metadata()
        .get_bool("tokenizer.ggml.add_bos_token")
        .unwrap_or(false);
    if add_bos {
        if let Some(bos) = info.bos_token_id {
            prompt_ids.insert(0, bos);
        }
    }
    let eos: Vec<u32> = info.eos_token_id.into_iter().collect();
    println!(
        "sweep: prompt {prompt:?} -> ids {prompt_ids:?}; depths {depths:?}; {n_tokens} tokens per depth"
    );
    let _ = std::io::stdout().flush();

    let sweep = SweepConfig {
        depths,
        tokens_per_depth: n_tokens,
        ..SweepConfig::default()
    };
    let base = SpecConfig::default();
    let factory = |config: &SpecConfig| build_session(target_path, draft_path, &eos, config);
    let report =
        run_sweep(&sweep, &base, &prompt_ids, factory, &StderrDiag).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    println!();
    print!("{}", report.render_table());
    let _ = std::io::stdout().flush();
    Ok(())
}

===== FILE: crates/itak-spec/examples/spec_sweep_gpu.rs =====
//! Depth and acceptance sweep for the speculative loop on the
//! GPU-resident stack (TODO T-9.7): the library's [`run_sweep`]
//! wired to a factory that builds each depth's session over
//! `wgpu-compute`'s resident target session with the DFlash
//! draft on its GPU resident path (the `spec_generate_gpu`
//! runner's phase B wiring), so the sweep measures the GPU
//! loop's real depth curve instead of the CPU reference's.
//!
//! Usage: `spec_sweep_gpu <target.gguf> <draft.gguf> [depths|default] [n_tokens] [prompt]`
//!
//! `depths` is a comma-separated candidate list (`1,2,4,6`) or
//! the word `default` for the configured candidate set
//! ([`SweepConfig::default`]: [1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16]);
//! `n_tokens` is the per-depth generation budget (default: the
//! configured budget, 128); `prompt` defaults to the Stage 1
//! prompt. Temperature is 0 (greedy), as in the CPU sweep.
//!
//! Each depth reloads both models and builds a fresh session
//! (the CPU example's discipline): peak memory is one depth's
//! footprint. Loads and prefill sit outside the measured wall
//! (`run_sweep` times `generate` only). Server run, GPU free:
//!
//! `cargo run --release -p itak-spec --example spec_sweep_gpu -- /mnt/models/Muse-Glimmer-30B/Muse-Glimmer-30B-KQuant-17GB-Q4_K_M.gguf /mnt/models/Muse-Glimmer-30B/dflash-Muse-Glimmer-30B-Q4_K_M.gguf`
//!
//! NOTE (server proof, 2026-11-04): `run_sweep` as merged was
//! typed to the default `SpecSession` (CPU driver). Wiring it
//! to the resident factory required widening `run_sweep` and
//! its `measure_depth` helper in `crates/itak-spec/src/sweep.rs`
//! to be generic over the session's `TargetDriver` (a two-line
//! signature change; the CPU callers infer the CPU driver
//! unchanged). That widening is part of this lane's patch set
//! and must land with this example.

use std::io::Write;
use std::path::Path;
use std::process::ExitCode;
use std::sync::Arc;

use dflash::StderrDiag as DflashStderrDiag;
use itak_spec::{
    run_sweep, DflashSpeculator, DraftBackend, ResidentTarget, SpecConfig, SpecSession, StderrDiag,
    SweepConfig,
};
use muse_glimmer::TensorSource as GlimmerTensorSource;
use tokenizer::{TokenType, Tokenizer, TokenizerData};
use wgpu_compute::{
    DflashRawWeights, DflashSession, DflashSessionConfig, ResidentSession, WgpuCompute,
};

fn main() -> ExitCode {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    let (Some(target_path), Some(draft_path)) = (args.get(1), args.get(2)) else {
        eprintln!(
            "usage: spec_sweep_gpu <target.gguf> <draft.gguf> [depths|default] [n_tokens] [prompt]"
        );
        return ExitCode::from(2);
    };
    let default_sweep = SweepConfig::default();
    let depths = match args.get(3).map(String::as_str) {
        None | Some("default") => default_sweep.depths.clone(),
        Some(text) => match SweepConfig::parse_depths(text) {
            Ok(depths) => depths,
            Err(err) => {
                eprintln!("FAIL: {err}");
                return ExitCode::from(2);
            }
        },
    };
    let n_tokens: usize = args.get(4).map_or(default_sweep.tokens_per_depth, |a| {
        a.parse().unwrap_or(default_sweep.tokens_per_depth)
    });
    let prompt = args
        .get(5)
        .map_or("The capital of France is", String::as_str);
    match run(target_path, draft_path, prompt, depths, n_tokens) {
        Ok(()) => ExitCode::SUCCESS,
        Err(msg) => {
            eprintln!("FAIL: {msg}");
            ExitCode::FAILURE
        }
    }
}

/// Same thin tokenizer adapter as the other integration runners.
fn data_from_info(
    info: &gguf::TokenizerInfo,
    model: Option<String>,
    unknown: Option<u32>,
) -> TokenizerData {
    TokenizerData {
        model,
        tokens: info.tokens.clone(),
        token_types: info
            .token_types
            .as_ref()
            .map(|types| types.iter().map(|&t| TokenType::from_gguf(t)).collect())
            .unwrap_or_default(),
        merges: info.merges.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
        scores: info.scores.clone(),
        bos_token_id: info.bos_token_id,
        eos_token_id: info.eos_token_id,
        unknown_token_id: unknown,
        padding_token_id: info.padding_token_id,
    }
}

/// Build one depth's session over the GPU-resident stack: the
/// factory [`run_sweep`] calls per depth. Mirrors
/// `spec_generate_gpu`'s phase B exactly: one leaked backend
/// serves both residents, the draft loads raw (no CPU
/// dequantization), and the target resident session is built
/// through the loader coverage gate. The backend handle leaks
/// per depth (one small allocation per depth, process-lifetime;
/// the sessions and their device state drop between depths).
fn build_session(
    target_path: &str,
    draft_path: &str,
    eos: &[u32],
    config: &SpecConfig,
) -> Result<SpecSession<ResidentTarget<'static>>, String> {
    let draft_file = gguf::GgufFile::open(Path::new(draft_path)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let dcfg = itak_loader::load_dflash_config(&draft_file).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let report = itak_loader::coverage_dflash(&draft_file, &dcfg);
    report.require_complete().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

    let target_file = gguf::GgufFile::open(Path::new(target_path)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let gcfg = itak_loader::load_config(&target_file).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let report = itak_loader::coverage(&target_file, &gcfg);
    report.require_complete().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

    let backend: &'static WgpuCompute =
        Box::leak(Box::new(WgpuCompute::new().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?));

    // The GPU draft arm (the runner's default selection).
    let draft_source = itak_loader::GgufTensorSource::new(&draft_file);
    let raw = DflashRawWeights::load(&draft_source, &dcfg).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let target_source = itak_loader::GgufTensorSource::new(&target_file);
    let embedding = GlimmerTensorSource::tensor(&target_source, "token_embd.weight")
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let output_head =
        GlimmerTensorSource::tensor(&target_source, "output.weight").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let draft_session = DflashSession::with_diag(
        backend,
        &dcfg,
        &raw,
        Some(&embedding),
        Some(&output_head),
        DflashSessionConfig::default(),
        Arc::new(DflashStderrDiag),
    )
    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let speculator = DflashSpeculator::gpu(draft_session);

    // The resident target on the same backend.
    let weights = itak_loader::load_weights(&target_file, &gcfg).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let session = ResidentSession::new(backend, &gcfg, &weights).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

    let mut config = config.clone();
    config.draft_backend = DraftBackend::Gpu;
    config.eos_tokens = eos.to_vec();
    SpecSession::new(
        ResidentTarget::new(session),
        Some(speculator),
        config,
        Arc::new(StderrDiag),
    )
    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

fn run(
    target_path: &str,
    draft_path: &str,
    prompt: &str,
    depths: Vec<usize>,
    n_tokens: usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    // Tokenize once: every depth sees the identical prompt and
    // stop set (the CPU sweep example's discipline).
    let target_file = gguf::GgufFile::open(Path::new(target_path)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let info = target_file.tokenizer().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let tok_model = target_file
        .metadata()
        .opt_string("tokenizer.ggml.model")
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        .map(str::to_string);
    let tokenizer =
        Tokenizer::new(data_from_info(&info, tok_model, None)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut prompt_ids = tokenizer.encode(prompt).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let add_bos = target_file
        .metadata()
        .get_bool("tokenizer.ggml.add_bos_token")
        .unwrap_or(false);
    if add_bos {
        if let Some(bos) = info.bos_token_id {
            prompt_ids.insert(0, bos);
        }
    }
    let eos: Vec<u32> = info.eos_token_id.into_iter().collect();
    println!(
        "sweep (gpu): prompt {prompt:?} -> ids {prompt_ids:?}; depths {depths:?}; {n_tokens} tokens per depth"
    );
    let _ = std::io::stdout().flush();

    let sweep = SweepConfig {
        depths,
        tokens_per_depth: n_tokens,
        ..SweepConfig::default()
    };
    let base = SpecConfig {
        draft_backend: DraftBackend::Gpu,
        ..SpecConfig::default()
    };
    let factory = |config: &SpecConfig| build_session(target_path, draft_path, &eos, config);
    let report =
        run_sweep(&sweep, &base, &prompt_ids, factory, &StderrDiag).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    println!();
    print!("{}", report.render_table());
    let _ = std::io::stdout().flush();
    Ok(())
}

===== FILE: crates/itak-spec/src/config.rs =====
//! Session configuration (SPEC-itak-spec Section 6.3). Every operational
//! limit here is configuration with a default, never a compiled-in
//! constant: the depth default is the winner of this stack's own T-9.7
//! sweep, measured on the resident GPU loop on 2026-11-04
//! (`bench/spec-sweep-gpu-fixed-2026-11-04.md`, depth 1 at 16.86 tok/s
//! with acceptance 0.615, picked by SPEC 9.4's smallest-depth-within-2%
//! rule). It supersedes the llama.cpp operating point (depth 6) this
//! default carried before the sweep ran.

/// Which drafting machinery a session runs.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum SpecMode {
    /// No speculation: the session generates plainly and reports
    /// `spec.disabled` once at creation.
    Off,
    /// DFlash block drafting (the mode this crate implements).
    Dflash,
    /// N-gram prompt-lookup drafting: implemented by
    /// [`crate::NgramProposer`], attached through
    /// `SpecSession::new_ngram`. Selecting it through the DFlash
    /// constructor (`SpecSession::new`) refuses with
    /// `ModeUnavailable`, because the proposer is not attached there.
    Ngram,
    /// Medusa tree drafting: named in the spec, machinery not in this
    /// crate; selecting it refuses with `ModeUnavailable`.
    Medusa,
}

impl SpecMode {
    /// The mode name as it appears in configuration and diagnostics.
    pub fn name(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            SpecMode::Off => "off",
            SpecMode::Dflash => "dflash",
            SpecMode::Ngram => "ngram",
            SpecMode::Medusa => "medusa",
        }
    }

    /// Parse the stable name back into a mode: the vocabulary the
    /// runners' mode switches accept, [`DraftBackend::parse`]'s twin.
    /// Unknown text returns `None`; the caller refuses by name.
    pub fn parse(text: &str) -> Option<SpecMode> {
        match text {
            "off" => Some(SpecMode::Off),
            "dflash" => Some(SpecMode::Dflash),
            "ngram" => Some(SpecMode::Ngram),
            "medusa" => Some(SpecMode::Medusa),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
}

/// Which device path the DFlash draft model runs on. The
/// two arms are the same semantics behind the same
/// [`crate::Speculator`] seam (the CPU implementation in
/// the `dflash` crate is the reference; the GPU arm is
/// wgpu-compute's resident draft session, held to it by
/// the cross-backend parity tests); the choice is config
/// with a default, never a compiled constant.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub enum DraftBackend {
    /// The CPU reference implementation (`dflash::DflashModel`).
    #[default]
    Cpu,
    /// The device-resident GPU session
    /// (`wgpu_compute::DflashSession`).
    Gpu,
}

impl DraftBackend {
    /// The backend name as it appears in configuration,
    /// runner flags, and diagnostics.
    pub fn name(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            DraftBackend::Cpu => "cpu",
            DraftBackend::Gpu => "gpu",
        }
    }

    /// Parse a backend name (`cpu` or `gpu`), the runner
    /// flag's vocabulary. Anything else is `None`, and the
    /// caller refuses by name rather than guessing.
    pub fn parse(text: &str) -> Option<Self> {
        match text {
            "cpu" => Some(DraftBackend::Cpu),
            "gpu" => Some(DraftBackend::Gpu),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
}

/// What a round does when the target's verify forward refuses
/// (SPEC-itak-spec Section 4, step 8).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum OnVerifyError {
    /// Roll back to the round's base and surface the refusal. The default:
    /// a sick target is never papered over.
    Refuse,
    /// Roll back, latch speculation off for the rest of the session with a
    /// `spec.fallback.latched` event, and finish the round as one plain
    /// step. Never silent: the latch is in the stats and the event log.
    LatchOff,
}

/// Everything that tunes a session, validated at creation.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct SpecConfig {
    /// Drafting mode. Default: DFlash.
    pub mode: SpecMode,
    /// Which device path the DFlash draft runs on. This is
    /// a construction-time selection (it decides which
    /// speculator the caller builds), recorded in the
    /// session config so a run's provenance states it.
    /// Default: CPU, the reference implementation; the GPU
    /// arm is the resident draft session in wgpu-compute.
    pub draft_backend: DraftBackend,
    /// Maximum draft tokens proposed per round. Default: 1, the winner
    /// of this stack's T-9.7 sweep on 2026-11-04 (acceptance 0.615,
    /// 16.86 tok/s; see `bench/spec-sweep-gpu-fixed-2026-11-04.md`).
    /// Must be at least 1 and at most the
    /// draft's block size; creation refuses out-of-range depths by name.
    /// The T-9.7 sweep that re-measures this default on this stack lives
    /// in [`crate::sweep`]; its candidate set is configuration there
    /// ([`crate::SweepConfig`]), never a constant compiled into the loop.
    pub depth: usize,
    /// Per-round token bound handed to the KV checkpoint: a round touches
    /// at most this many positions past its base. Must hold `depth + 1`
    /// (the pending token plus the drafts). Default: 17, llama.cpp's own
    /// default speculation envelope.
    pub max_round_tokens: usize,
    /// Target sampling temperature. Zero (the default) is greedy: the
    /// emitted sequence is then token-identical to non-speculative greedy
    /// generation, which is the loop's standing proof obligation.
    pub temperature: f32,
    /// Nucleus (top-p) cutoff applied to the target distribution when
    /// sampling, with the engine sampler's semantics. Values outside
    /// `(0, 1)` disable truncation. Default: 1.0 (disabled).
    pub top_p: f32,
    /// Temperature for the draft's own distributions. `None` (the default)
    /// follows the target temperature, per the spec's default. The draft
    /// distribution never gets nucleus truncation: q enters the correction
    /// ratio raw, exactly as the draft produced it.
    pub draft_temperature: Option<f32>,
    /// Verify-refusal policy. Default: refuse.
    pub on_verify_error: OnVerifyError,
    /// Whether a grammar constraint is active for this session. Grammar
    /// plus speculation refuses at creation (`GrammarConflict`) until a
    /// grammar-aware correction walk exists.
    pub grammar_active: bool,
    /// Stop tokens: emitting one truncates the stream at that token
    /// (inclusive) and ends the session. Default: empty.
    pub eos_tokens: Vec<u32>,
    /// Seed for the session's private generator. Only temperature sampling
    /// consumes draws. Default: 0 (remapped internally, still
    /// reproducible).
    pub seed: u64,
}

impl Default for SpecConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        SpecConfig {
            mode: SpecMode::Dflash,
            draft_backend: DraftBackend::Cpu,
            depth: 1,
            max_round_tokens: 17,
            temperature: 0.0,
            top_p: 1.0,
            draft_temperature: None,
            on_verify_error: OnVerifyError::Refuse,
            grammar_active: false,
            eos_tokens: Vec::new(),
            seed: 0,
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn draft_backend_default_is_cpu_and_parses_by_name() {
        // The library default stays the CPU reference; the
        // GPU arm is always an explicit selection.
        assert_eq!(SpecConfig::default().draft_backend, DraftBackend::Cpu);
        assert_eq!(DraftBackend::default(), DraftBackend::Cpu);
        assert_eq!(DraftBackend::parse("cpu"), Some(DraftBackend::Cpu));
        assert_eq!(DraftBackend::parse("gpu"), Some(DraftBackend::Gpu));
        assert_eq!(DraftBackend::parse("GPU"), None);
        assert_eq!(DraftBackend::parse(""), None);
        assert_eq!(DraftBackend::Cpu.name(), "cpu");
        assert_eq!(DraftBackend::Gpu.name(), "gpu");
    }

    #[test]
    fn spec_mode_names_round_trip_through_parse() {
        for mode in [
            SpecMode::Off,
            SpecMode::Dflash,
            SpecMode::Ngram,
            SpecMode::Medusa,
        ] {
            assert_eq!(SpecMode::parse(mode.name()), Some(mode));
        }
        assert_eq!(SpecMode::parse("NGRAM"), None);
        assert_eq!(SpecMode::parse(""), None);
        assert_eq!(SpecMode::parse("prompt-lookup"), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn runner_drafter_vocabulary_accepts_only_dflash_and_ngram() {
        // The runners' `--drafter` guard (both `spec_generate`
        // and `spec_generate_gpu`): parse with the shared
        // parser, then admit exactly the two implemented
        // draft sources. Modes that parse but are not draft
        // sources on a runner (`off`, `medusa`), the GPU
        // runner's separate `--draft` backend vocabulary
        // (`gpu`, `cpu`), and unknown text all refuse by name
        // in the runners; this pins the parse half of that
        // guard beside the round-trip coverage above.
        let admitted = |text: &str| {
            matches!(
                SpecMode::parse(text),
                Some(SpecMode::Dflash | SpecMode::Ngram)
            )
        };
        assert!(admitted("dflash"));
        assert!(admitted("ngram"));
        for refused in ["off", "medusa", "gpu", "cpu", "", "NGRAM", "prompt-lookup"] {
            assert!(!admitted(refused), "--drafter={refused:?} must refuse");
        }
    }
}

===== FILE: crates/itak-spec/src/diag.rs =====
//! The diagnostic seam for the speculation loop (SPEC-itak-spec Section
//! 6.4). Every refusal, round, rewind, commit, and fallback emits through
//! this trait, so the engine can route the loop's evidence wherever its own
//! diagnostics go. The catalogue:
//!
//! - `spec.session.begin` / `spec.session.end`: session lifecycle, with the
//!   mode, depth, and (at the end) the cumulative acceptance figures.
//! - `spec.disabled`: speculation was configured off; the session generates
//!   plainly and says so once, never silently.
//! - `spec.round.begin`: round number, cache base, pending token.
//! - `spec.propose.end`: drafts proposed, draft wall time.
//! - `spec.verify.end`: verify wall time.
//! - `spec.round.accept`: proposed, accepted, first rejection, emitted.
//! - `spec.cache.rewind` / `spec.cache.commit`: cache movements, from/to.
//! - `spec.fallback.latched`: a verify refusal latched speculation off;
//!   carries the reason and the round.
//! - `spec.refused`: a creation or round refusal, with the error text.
//! - `spec.sweep.begin` / `spec.sweep.end`: a depth sweep's lifecycle,
//!   with the candidate set and (at the end) the chosen default depth.
//! - `spec.sweep.row`: one measured depth: proposed, accepted,
//!   acceptance rate, effective tokens per second.
//! - `spec.sweep.refused`: the sweep stopped, with the depth it stopped
//!   at and the refusal text.

/// One sink for the loop's structured diagnostic events.
pub trait Diag: Send + Sync {
    /// Record one event: a dotted name plus `key=value` detail fields.
    fn event(&self, name: &str, detail: &str);
}

/// A sink that drops every event (tests and quiet embeddings).
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct NullDiag;

impl Diag for NullDiag {
    fn event(&self, _name: &str, _detail: &str) {}
}

/// A sink that writes events to stderr, one line each.
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct StderrDiag;

impl Diag for StderrDiag {
    fn event(&self, name: &str, detail: &str) {
        eprintln!("[diag] {name} {detail}");
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::sync::Mutex;

    /// A capturing sink in the itak-engine test shape: records every
    /// event so the test can prove the seam delivers what it is
    /// given, instead of trusting that sink wiring is present in the
    /// source.
    #[derive(Default)]
    struct Capture {
        events: Mutex<Vec<(String, String)>>,
    }

    impl Diag for Capture {
        fn event(&self, event: &str, detail: &str) {
            self.events
                .lock()
                .expect("capture lock")
                .push((event.to_string(), detail.to_string()));
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn seam_delivers_events_to_a_sink() {
        let capture = Capture::default();
        capture.event("seam_probe", "detail=fired");
        let events = capture.events.lock().expect("capture lock");
        assert!(
            events
                .iter()
                .any(|(e, d)| e == "seam_probe" && d == "detail=fired"),
            "a sink must receive the events emitted through the seam"
        );
        drop(events);
        // The shipped sinks behave: NullDiag drops silently and
        // StderrDiag writes without panicking.
        NullDiag.event("seam_probe", "detail=dropped");
        StderrDiag.event("seam_probe", "detail=stderr");
    }
}
