===== FILE: crates/wgpu-compute/tests/cross_backend.rs =====
//! The cross-backend proof: one synthetic multi-layer Glimmer
//! model, the same weights and token sequence through
//! `cpu-compute` (the verified reference) and `wgpu-compute`,
//! comparing per-token logits.
//!
//! The fixture keeps the real model's head geometry (32 Q heads,
//! 2 KV heads, head dim 128) and scales only what is
//! size-invariant: hidden 512, FFN 1024, vocab 1024, six layers
//! in a sliding/global mix, sliding window 4 so a 9-token
//! sequence forces ring eviction on the sliding layers. Every
//! projection, the embedding, and the head are K-quantized
//! (Q4_K, the head Q5_K like the real file's family mix), built
//! by-construction from deterministic block payloads, so both
//! backends consume byte-identical weights; the norms are F32.
//!
//! Pass bar, stated up front: top-1 (argmax) agreement at every
//! step, and max-abs logit difference under 0.5 (the logits are
//! softcapped to [-20, 20]; the two backends sum in different
//! orders, so exact equality is not the honest expectation).
//! Both numbers print at every step.
//!
//! Needs a discrete Vulkan GPU under the backend's default
//! policy; skips with a printed reason where none qualifies.

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;

use cpu_compute::CpuCompute;
use muse_glimmer::{
    expected_tensor_names, Cache, Dtype, GlimmerConfig, GlimmerError, GlimmerModel, LayerKind,
    PatternSource, PositionCache, Result, TensorSource, TensorView, Weights,
};
use wgpu_compute::kernels::k1_q4k_gemv::f32_to_f16_bits;
use wgpu_compute::{WgpuCompute, WgpuError};

/// A tiny deterministic byte/float source.
struct Rng(u64);

impl Rng {
    fn next_u8(&mut self) -> u8 {
        self.0 = self
            .0
            .wrapping_mul(6_364_136_223_846_793_005)
            .wrapping_add(1_442_695_040_888_963_407);
        (self.0 >> 56) as u8
    }

    /// A value in [-0.5, 0.5).
    fn next_f32(&mut self) -> f32 {
        self.next_u8() as f32 / 256.0 - 0.5
    }
}

/// A Q4_K tensor of shape [inn, out] (GGUF stored order) from
/// by-construction blocks: small f16 header scales, packed 6-bit
/// sub-block scales held to 0..=7, random nibbles. The values
/// this encodes stay near +-0.5, so a six-layer random network
/// produces well-scaled logits on both backends.
fn q4k_tensor(rng: &mut Rng, name: &str, inn: usize, out: usize) -> TensorView {
    let blocks = inn * out / 256;
    let mut data = Vec::with_capacity(blocks * 144);
    for _ in 0..blocks {
        data.extend_from_slice(&f32_to_f16_bits(0.005).to_le_bytes());
        data.extend_from_slice(&f32_to_f16_bits(0.002).to_le_bytes());
        for _ in 0..12 {
            data.push(rng.next_u8() & 0x07);
        }
        for _ in 0..128 {
            data.push(rng.next_u8());
        }
    }
    TensorView {
        name: name.to_string(),
        dtype: Dtype::Q4K,
        shape: vec![inn as u64, out as u64],
        data: Arc::from(data.into_boxed_slice()),
    }
}

/// A Q5_K tensor of shape [inn, out], same construction
/// discipline as [`q4k_tensor`] (the head's family in the real
/// file).
fn q5k_tensor(rng: &mut Rng, name: &str, inn: usize, out: usize) -> TensorView {
    let blocks = inn * out / 256;
    let mut data = Vec::with_capacity(blocks * 176);
    for _ in 0..blocks {
        data.extend_from_slice(&f32_to_f16_bits(0.005).to_le_bytes());
        data.extend_from_slice(&f32_to_f16_bits(0.002).to_le_bytes());
        for _ in 0..12 {
            data.push(rng.next_u8() & 0x07);
        }
        for _ in 0..32 {
            data.push(rng.next_u8());
        }
        for _ in 0..128 {
            data.push(rng.next_u8());
        }
    }
    TensorView {
        name: name.to_string(),
        dtype: Dtype::Q5K,
        shape: vec![inn as u64, out as u64],
        data: Arc::from(data.into_boxed_slice()),
    }
}

/// An F32 tensor whose values cluster around `center`.
fn f32_tensor(rng: &mut Rng, name: &str, shape: &[u64], center: f32) -> TensorView {
    let count: u64 = shape.iter().product();
    let data: Vec<u8> = (0..count)
        .flat_map(|_| (center + rng.next_f32()).to_le_bytes())
        .collect();
    TensorView {
        name: name.to_string(),
        dtype: Dtype::F32,
        shape: shape.to_vec(),
        data: Arc::from(data.into_boxed_slice()),
    }
}

/// The synthetic config: real head geometry, scaled-down widths,
/// a sliding/global layer mix, window 4.
fn cross_cfg() -> GlimmerConfig {
    GlimmerConfig {
        name: None,
        block_count: 6,
        context_length: 256,
        hidden: 512,
        ffn_hidden: 1024,
        q_heads: 32,
        kv_heads: 2,
        key_length: 128,
        value_length: 128,
        rope_freq_base: 500_000.0,
        rope_freq_base_swa: 500_000.0,
        rms_eps: 1e-5,
        sliding_window: 4,
        logit_softcap: 20.0,
        logit_scale: 0.196_116_13,
        vocab_size: 1024,
        layers: vec![
            LayerKind::SlidingWindow,
            LayerKind::SlidingWindow,
            LayerKind::SlidingWindow,
            LayerKind::Global,
            LayerKind::SlidingWindow,
            LayerKind::Global,
        ],
        pattern_source: PatternSource::MeasuredFallback,
    }
}

/// Build the full weight set for `cfg`, keyed by the exact names
/// `Weights::load` will ask for.
fn cross_weights(cfg: &GlimmerConfig) -> Weights {
    struct MapSource {
        tensors: HashMap<String, TensorView>,
    }
    impl TensorSource for MapSource {
        fn tensor(&self, name: &str) -> Result<TensorView> {
            self.tensors
                .get(name)
                .cloned()
                .ok_or_else(|| GlimmerError::MissingTensor {
                    name: name.to_string(),
                })
        }
    }

    let hidden = cfg.hidden as usize;
    let ffn = cfg.ffn_hidden as usize;
    let q_width = cfg.q_width() as usize;
    let kv_width = cfg.k_width() as usize;
    let vocab = cfg.vocab_size as usize;
    let head_dim = cfg.key_length as usize;

    let mut rng = Rng(0x5eed_c0de);
    let mut tensors: HashMap<String, TensorView> = HashMap::new();
    for name in expected_tensor_names(cfg) {
        let view = if name == "token_embd.weight" {
            q4k_tensor(&mut rng, &name, hidden, vocab)
        } else if name == "output.weight" {
            q5k_tensor(&mut rng, &name, hidden, vocab)
        } else if name == "output_norm.weight" {
            // The real file's final norm is deliberately
            // unshifted, so its weights center on zero; mirror
            // that here.
            f32_tensor(&mut rng, &name, &[hidden as u64], 0.0)
        } else if name.ends_with("attn_q_norm.weight") || name.ends_with("attn_k_norm.weight") {
            f32_tensor(&mut rng, &name, &[head_dim as u64], 1.0)
        } else if name.ends_with("attn_norm.weight")
            || name.ends_with("post_attention_norm.weight")
            || name.ends_with("ffn_norm.weight")
            || name.ends_with("post_ffw_norm.weight")
        {
            f32_tensor(&mut rng, &name, &[hidden as u64], 1.0)
        } else if name.ends_with("attn_q.weight") || name.ends_with("attn_gate.weight") {
            q4k_tensor(&mut rng, &name, hidden, q_width)
        } else if name.ends_with("attn_k.weight") || name.ends_with("attn_v.weight") {
            q4k_tensor(&mut rng, &name, hidden, kv_width)
        } else if name.ends_with("attn_output.weight") {
            q4k_tensor(&mut rng, &name, q_width, hidden)
        } else if name.ends_with("ffn_gate.weight") || name.ends_with("ffn_up.weight") {
            q4k_tensor(&mut rng, &name, hidden, ffn)
        } else if name.ends_with("ffn_down.weight") {
            q4k_tensor(&mut rng, &name, ffn, hidden)
        } else {
            panic!("no fixture rule for tensor {name}");
        };
        tensors.insert(name, view);
    }
    Weights::load(&MapSource { tensors }, cfg).expect("fixture weights load")
}

fn argmax(logits: &[f32]) -> usize {
    logits
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .max_by(|a, b| a.1.partial_cmp(b.1).expect("logits are finite"))
        .map(|(i, _)| i)
        .expect("logits are non-empty")
}

fn max_abs(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f32 {
    assert_eq!(a.len(), b.len());
    a.iter()
        .zip(b.iter())
        .map(|(x, y)| (x - y).abs())
        .fold(0.0f32, f32::max)
}

#[test]
fn cross_backend_greedy_generation_agrees() {
    let gpu_backend = match WgpuCompute::new() {
        Ok(b) => b,
        Err(WgpuError::NoSuitableAdapter { seen, .. }) => {
            eprintln!(
                "skipping cross-backend test: no suitable adapter (enumerated: [{}])",
                seen.join("; ")
            );
            return;
        }
        Err(e) => panic!("backend construction failed unexpectedly: {e}"),
    };
    let cfg = cross_cfg();
    let weights = cross_weights(&cfg);
    let cpu_model = GlimmerModel::new(cfg.clone(), weights.clone(), Box::new(CpuCompute::new()));
    let gpu_model = GlimmerModel::new(cfg, weights, Box::new(gpu_backend));

    let mut cpu_cache = PositionCache::new();
    let mut gpu_cache = PositionCache::new();

    // Prompt of 4, then 5 greedy decode steps: 9 positions
    // through a window of 4.
    let mut next = vec![3u32, 100, 57, 900];
    let mut worst = 0.0f32;
    for step in 0..6 {
        let cpu_logits = cpu_model
            .forward(&next, &mut cpu_cache)
            .expect("cpu forward");
        let gpu_logits = gpu_model
            .forward(&next, &mut gpu_cache)
            .expect("gpu forward");
        let d = max_abs(&cpu_logits, &gpu_logits);
        worst = worst.max(d);
        let cpu_top = argmax(&cpu_logits);
        let gpu_top = argmax(&gpu_logits);
        eprintln!(
            "step {step}: fed {} token(s) at position {}, max abs logit diff {d:.4e}, \
             top-1 cpu {cpu_top} gpu {gpu_top}",
            next.len(),
            cpu_cache.position() - next.len(),
        );
        assert_eq!(
            cpu_top, gpu_top,
            "top-1 disagreement at step {step} (max abs diff {d})"
        );
        assert!(
            d < 0.5,
            "logit drift beyond the stated bound at step {step}: {d}"
        );
        assert_eq!(cpu_cache.position(), gpu_cache.position());
        next = vec![cpu_top as u32];
    }
    eprintln!(
        "cross-backend: 6 forwards agreed on top-1 throughout; worst max abs diff {worst:.4e}"
    );
}

===== END FILE: crates/wgpu-compute/tests/cross_backend.rs =====

===== FILE: crates/wgpu-compute/tests/dflash_session.rs =====
//! The DFlash GPU session parity pin: `DflashSession`
//! against the CPU implementation (`dflash::DflashModel`,
//! the arch's correctness oracle) on a synthetic fixture,
//! at the cross-backend bar the resident tests use
//! (per-row argmax agreement and max-abs logit difference
//! under 0.5).
//!
//! The fixture is built so both paths consume THE SAME
//! values: every tensor is synthesized once as stored
//! GGUF bytes (the real file's dtype families: Q4_K
//! projections, Q6_K value/down, F32 norms, a Q5_K
//! borrowed head); the GPU session uploads those bytes,
//! and the CPU model is fed their dequantization. Any
//! divergence is therefore the device's arithmetic, not a
//! fixture mismatch.
//!
//! The fixture's geometry exercises the draft-specific
//! paths the Glimmer fixture cannot: three layers with a
//! sliding/global/sliding pattern and window 3 (so the
//! mask genuinely bites at the block positions used), a
//! post-norm pair on the middle layer, a sparse committed
//! set (gaps in the injected positions), and the borrowed
//! embedding/head state (the fixture draft carries
//! neither of its own).
//!
//! Adapter-bound tests skip with a printed reason where
//! no adapter qualifies, the resident tests' discipline;
//! the raw-load refusal tests are pure CPU and run
//! everywhere.

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;

use dflash::{
    DflashCache, DflashConfig, DflashError, DflashModel, TargetTensors, TensorData,
    Weights as CpuWeights,
};
use gguf::ggml::GgmlType;
use muse_glimmer::{Dtype, GlimmerError, Result as GlimmerResult, TensorSource, TensorView};
use wgpu_compute::kernels::k1_q4k_gemv::f32_to_f16_bits;
use wgpu_compute::{DflashRawWeights, DflashSession, DflashSessionConfig, WgpuCompute, WgpuError};

/// A tiny deterministic byte/float source (the
/// cross-backend fixture's generator, same seed
/// discipline as the resident tests).
struct Rng(u64);

impl Rng {
    fn next_u8(&mut self) -> u8 {
        self.0 = self
            .0
            .wrapping_mul(6_364_136_223_846_793_005)
            .wrapping_add(1_442_695_040_888_963_407);
        (self.0 >> 56) as u8
    }

    /// A value in [-0.5, 0.5).
    fn next_f32(&mut self) -> f32 {
        self.next_u8() as f32 / 256.0 - 0.5
    }
}

/// A Q4_K tensor of shape [inn, out] from by-construction
/// blocks, exactly the resident fixture's construction.
fn q4k_tensor(rng: &mut Rng, name: &str, inn: usize, out: usize) -> TensorView {
    let blocks = inn * out / 256;
    let mut data = Vec::with_capacity(blocks * 144);
    for _ in 0..blocks {
        data.extend_from_slice(&f32_to_f16_bits(0.005).to_le_bytes());
        data.extend_from_slice(&f32_to_f16_bits(0.002).to_le_bytes());
        for _ in 0..12 {
            data.push(rng.next_u8() & 0x07);
        }
        for _ in 0..128 {
            data.push(rng.next_u8());
        }
    }
    TensorView {
        name: name.to_string(),
        dtype: Dtype::Q4K,
        shape: vec![inn as u64, out as u64],
        data: Arc::from(data.into_boxed_slice()),
    }
}

/// A Q5_K tensor of shape [inn, out], same construction.
fn q5k_tensor(rng: &mut Rng, name: &str, inn: usize, out: usize) -> TensorView {
    let blocks = inn * out / 256;
    let mut data = Vec::with_capacity(blocks * 176);
    for _ in 0..blocks {
        data.extend_from_slice(&f32_to_f16_bits(0.005).to_le_bytes());
        data.extend_from_slice(&f32_to_f16_bits(0.002).to_le_bytes());
        for _ in 0..12 {
            data.push(rng.next_u8() & 0x07);
        }
        for _ in 0..32 {
            data.push(rng.next_u8());
        }
        for _ in 0..128 {
            data.push(rng.next_u8());
        }
    }
    TensorView {
        name: name.to_string(),
        dtype: Dtype::Q5K,
        shape: vec![inn as u64, out as u64],
        data: Arc::from(data.into_boxed_slice()),
    }
}

/// A Q6_K tensor of shape [inn, out]: 210-byte blocks
/// (ql, qh, i8 scales, f16 d), sane magnitudes by
/// construction.
fn q6k_tensor(rng: &mut Rng, name: &str, inn: usize, out: usize) -> TensorView {
    let blocks = inn * out / 256;
    let mut data = Vec::with_capacity(blocks * 210);
    for _ in 0..blocks {
        for _ in 0..128 {
            data.push(rng.next_u8());
        }
        for _ in 0..64 {
            data.push(rng.next_u8());
        }
        for _ in 0..16 {
            data.push(rng.next_u8() % 5);
        }
        data.extend_from_slice(&f32_to_f16_bits(0.01).to_le_bytes());
    }
    TensorView {
        name: name.to_string(),
        dtype: Dtype::Q6K,
        shape: vec![inn as u64, out as u64],
        data: Arc::from(data.into_boxed_slice()),
    }
}

/// An F32 tensor whose values cluster around `center`.
fn f32_tensor(rng: &mut Rng, name: &str, shape: &[u64], center: f32) -> TensorView {
    let count: u64 = shape.iter().product();
    let data: Vec<u8> = (0..count)
        .flat_map(|_| (center + rng.next_f32()).to_le_bytes())
        .collect();
    TensorView {
        name: name.to_string(),
        dtype: Dtype::F32,
        shape: shape.to_vec(),
        data: Arc::from(data.into_boxed_slice()),
    }
}

/// A raw view source over a name map (the loader's shape,
/// minus the file).
struct MapSource {
    tensors: HashMap<String, TensorView>,
}

impl TensorSource for MapSource {
    fn tensor(&self, name: &str) -> GlimmerResult<TensorView> {
        self.tensors
            .get(name)
            .cloned()
            .ok_or_else(|| GlimmerError::MissingTensor {
                name: name.to_string(),
            })
    }
}

/// The CPU source over the same map: every tensor
/// dequantized from the very bytes the GPU uploads.
struct CpuSource {
    tensors: HashMap<String, TensorView>,
}

fn dequantized(view: &TensorView) -> TensorData {
    let ty = match view.dtype {
        Dtype::F32 => GgmlType::F32,
        Dtype::F16 => GgmlType::F16,
        Dtype::Bf16 => GgmlType::Bf16,
        Dtype::Q4K => GgmlType::Q4K,
        Dtype::Q5K => GgmlType::Q5K,
        Dtype::Q6K => GgmlType::Q6K,
        Dtype::Q8_0 => GgmlType::Q8_0,
        other => panic!("fixture dtype {other:?} has no dequantizer mapping"),
    };
    let count: usize = view.shape.iter().map(|d| *d as usize).product();
    TensorData {
        name: view.name.clone(),
        shape: view.shape.clone(),
        data: gguf::dequant::dequantize(ty, &view.data, count),
    }
}

impl dflash::TensorSource for CpuSource {
    fn tensor(&self, name: &str) -> dflash::Result<TensorData> {
        self.tensors
            .get(name)
            .map(dequantized)
            .ok_or_else(|| DflashError::MissingTensor {
                name: name.to_string(),
            })
    }

    fn has_tensor(&self, name: &str) -> bool {
        self.tensors.contains_key(name)
    }
}

/// The fixture config: real head geometry scaled down to
/// kernel-legal widths (every Q4_K/Q6_K input a whole
/// number of 256-blocks), a sliding/global/sliding
/// pattern with window 3, two target layers over a
/// 256-wide target.
fn fixture_cfg() -> DflashConfig {
    DflashConfig {
        name: None,
        block_count: 3,
        context_length: 128,
        hidden: 256,
        ffn_hidden: 512,
        q_heads: 4,
        kv_heads: 2,
        key_length: 64,
        value_length: 64,
        rope_freq_base: 10_000.0,
        rms_eps: 1e-5,
        block_size: 4,
        target_layers: vec![0, 2],
        sliding_window: 3,
        sliding_pattern: vec![true, false, true],
        causal_attention: false,
        mask_token_id: 511,
        vocab_size: 512,
    }
}

/// Build the fixture's draft tensor map (no embedding,
/// no head: the borrowed state), plus the target's two
/// tables as separate views.
fn fixture_tensors(cfg: &DflashConfig) -> (HashMap<String, TensorView>, TensorView, TensorView) {
    let hidden = cfg.hidden as usize;
    let ffn = cfg.ffn_hidden as usize;
    let q_w = cfg.q_width() as usize;
    let k_w = cfg.k_width() as usize;
    let out_w = cfg.attn_out_width() as usize;
    let vocab = cfg.vocab_size as usize;
    let head_dim = cfg.key_length as usize;
    let cond = cfg.target_layers.len() * hidden;

    let mut rng = Rng(0xd15c_0de5);
    let mut tensors: HashMap<String, TensorView> = HashMap::new();
    let mut put = |view: TensorView| {
        tensors.insert(view.name.clone(), view);
    };
    put(q4k_tensor(&mut rng, "fc.weight", cond, hidden));
    put(f32_tensor(
        &mut rng,
        "enc.output_norm.weight",
        &[hidden as u64],
        1.0,
    ));
    put(f32_tensor(
        &mut rng,
        "output_norm.weight",
        &[hidden as u64],
        1.0,
    ));
    for layer in 0..cfg.block_count {
        let p = |suffix: &str| format!("blk.{layer}.{suffix}");
        put(f32_tensor(
            &mut rng,
            &p("attn_norm.weight"),
            &[hidden as u64],
            1.0,
        ));
        put(q4k_tensor(&mut rng, &p("attn_q.weight"), hidden, q_w));
        put(q4k_tensor(&mut rng, &p("attn_k.weight"), hidden, k_w));
        put(q6k_tensor(&mut rng, &p("attn_v.weight"), hidden, k_w));
        put(f32_tensor(
            &mut rng,
            &p("attn_q_norm.weight"),
            &[head_dim as u64],
            1.0,
        ));
        put(f32_tensor(
            &mut rng,
            &p("attn_k_norm.weight"),
            &[head_dim as u64],
            1.0,
        ));
        put(q4k_tensor(
            &mut rng,
            &p("attn_output.weight"),
            out_w,
            hidden,
        ));
        if layer == 1 {
            put(f32_tensor(
                &mut rng,
                &p("post_attention_norm.weight"),
                &[hidden as u64],
                1.0,
            ));
            put(f32_tensor(
                &mut rng,
                &p("post_ffw_norm.weight"),
                &[hidden as u64],
                1.0,
            ));
        }
        put(f32_tensor(
            &mut rng,
            &p("ffn_norm.weight"),
            &[hidden as u64],
            1.0,
        ));
        put(q4k_tensor(&mut rng, &p("ffn_gate.weight"), hidden, ffn));
        put(q4k_tensor(&mut rng, &p("ffn_up.weight"), hidden, ffn));
        put(q6k_tensor(&mut rng, &p("ffn_down.weight"), ffn, hidden));
    }
    let embedding = q4k_tensor(&mut rng, "token_embd.weight", hidden, vocab);
    let output = q5k_tensor(&mut rng, "output.weight", hidden, vocab);
    (tensors, embedding, output)
}

/// Deterministic conditioning features for `positions`:
/// values in a tame range, distinct per row.
fn features_for(cfg: &DflashConfig, positions: &[usize]) -> Vec<f32> {
    let width = cfg.target_layers.len() * cfg.hidden as usize;
    let mut rng = Rng(0xfeed_0001 + positions.len() as u64);
    (0..positions.len() * width)
        .map(|_| rng.next_f32())
        .collect()
}

fn argmax(logits: &[f32]) -> usize {
    logits
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .max_by(|a, b| a.1.partial_cmp(b.1).expect("logits are finite"))
        .map(|(i, _)| i)
        .expect("logits are non-empty")
}

fn max_abs(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f32 {
    assert_eq!(a.len(), b.len());
    a.iter()
        .zip(b.iter())
        .map(|(x, y)| (x - y).abs())
        .fold(0.0f32, f32::max)
}

/// Build a backend or skip the test: the resident tests'
/// discipline (a missing adapter is an environment fact,
/// not a failure).
fn backend_or_skip(test: &str) -> Option<WgpuCompute> {
    match WgpuCompute::new() {
        Ok(b) => Some(b),
        Err(WgpuError::NoSuitableAdapter { seen, .. }) => {
            eprintln!(
                "skipping {test}: no suitable adapter (enumerated: [{}])",
                seen.join("; ")
            );
            None
        }
        Err(e) => panic!("backend construction failed unexpectedly: {e}"),
    }
}

/// The raw load's refusal shapes, CPU-only: they must
/// name the same errors the CPU load names for the same
/// broken files.
#[test]
fn raw_load_refusals_match_the_cpu_load() {
    let cfg = fixture_cfg();
    let (tensors, _, _) = fixture_tensors(&cfg);

    // Missing a required tensor.
    let mut broken = tensors.clone();
    broken.remove("blk.1.ffn_up.weight");
    let err = DflashRawWeights::load(&MapSource { tensors: broken }, &cfg)
        .expect_err("a missing tensor must refuse");
    assert!(
        matches!(&err, DflashError::MissingTensor { name } if name == "blk.1.ffn_up.weight"),
        "got {err}"
    );

    // A variant gate tensor present.
    let mut variant = tensors.clone();
    variant.insert(
        "markov_w1.weight".to_string(),
        f32_tensor(&mut Rng(7), "markov_w1.weight", &[4], 0.0),
    );
    let err = DflashRawWeights::load(&MapSource { tensors: variant }, &cfg)
        .expect_err("a variant file must refuse");
    assert!(
        matches!(&err, DflashError::UnsupportedFeature { name, .. } if name == "markov_w1.weight"),
        "got {err}"
    );

    // A wrong shape.
    let mut misshaped = tensors.clone();
    misshaped.insert(
        "blk.0.attn_q.weight".to_string(),
        q4k_tensor(&mut Rng(9), "blk.0.attn_q.weight", 256, 512),
    );
    let err = DflashRawWeights::load(&MapSource { tensors: misshaped }, &cfg)
        .expect_err("a misshaped tensor must refuse");
    assert!(
        matches!(&err, DflashError::ShapeMismatch { name, .. } if name == "blk.0.attn_q.weight"),
        "got {err}"
    );

    // fc width not a whole multiple of the target layer
    // count (3 target layers against a 512-wide fc).
    let mut cfg3 = fixture_cfg();
    cfg3.target_layers = vec![0, 1, 2];
    let err = DflashRawWeights::load(
        &MapSource {
            tensors: tensors.clone(),
        },
        &cfg3,
    )
    .expect_err("a non-multiple fc width must refuse");
    assert!(
        matches!(&err, DflashError::InvalidMetadata { key, .. } if key == "dflash.target_layers"),
        "got {err}"
    );

    // The intact fixture loads, and derives the same
    // scalars the CPU load derives.
    let raw = DflashRawWeights::load(
        &MapSource {
            tensors: tensors.clone(),
        },
        &cfg,
    )
    .expect("the intact fixture loads");
    assert_eq!(raw.conditioning_width(), 512);
    assert_eq!(raw.target_hidden, 256);
    assert!(raw.embedding.is_none() && raw.output.is_none());
    let cpu = CpuWeights::load(&CpuSource { tensors }, &cfg)
        .expect("the CPU load accepts the same fixture");
    assert_eq!(cpu.conditioning_width(), raw.conditioning_width());
    assert_eq!(cpu.target_hidden, raw.target_hidden);
}

/// The full parity run: fuse, inject, and block logits
/// against the CPU model, over a contiguous commit and
/// over a sparse one, with the session's refusal shapes
/// asserted at the end.
#[test]
fn dflash_session_matches_the_cpu_model() {
    let Some(backend) = backend_or_skip("dflash session parity test") else {
        return;
    };
    let cfg = fixture_cfg();
    let (tensors, emb_view, out_view) = fixture_tensors(&cfg);
    let raw = DflashRawWeights::load(
        &MapSource {
            tensors: tensors.clone(),
        },
        &cfg,
    )
    .expect("raw weights load");
    let cpu_weights = CpuWeights::load(&CpuSource { tensors }, &cfg).expect("cpu weights load");
    let cpu_model = DflashModel::new(cfg.clone(), cpu_weights);
    let emb_cpu = dequantized(&emb_view);
    let out_cpu = dequantized(&out_view);
    let target = TargetTensors {
        embedding: Some(&emb_cpu),
        output: Some(&out_cpu),
    };
    let vocab = cfg.vocab_size as usize;

    let mut session = DflashSession::new(
        &backend,
        &cfg,
        &raw,
        Some(&emb_view),
        Some(&out_view),
        DflashSessionConfig { kv_capacity: 64 },
    )
    .expect("draft session builds");
    assert_eq!(session.committed_len(), 0);
    assert_eq!(session.conditioning_width(), 512);

    // Round 1: a contiguous commit of eight positions,
    // then a noise block at 8.
    let positions: Vec<usize> = (0..8).collect();
    let features = features_for(&cfg, &positions);
    let cpu_fused = cpu_model
        .fuse(&features, positions.len())
        .expect("cpu fuse");
    let gpu_fused = session.fuse(&features, positions.len()).expect("gpu fuse");
    let d = max_abs(&cpu_fused, &gpu_fused);
    assert!(d < 0.5, "fuse drift beyond the cross-backend bar: {d}");

    let mut cache = DflashCache::new(&cfg);
    cpu_model
        .inject(&mut cache, &features, &positions)
        .expect("cpu inject");
    session.inject(&features, &positions).expect("gpu inject");
    assert_eq!(session.committed_len(), cache.len());
    assert_eq!(session.positions(), positions);

    let block = cpu_model.noise_block(42);
    let cpu_logits = cpu_model
        .forward_block(&cache, &block, 8, &target)
        .expect("cpu block");
    let gpu_logits = session.forward_block(&block, 8).expect("gpu block");
    assert_eq!(gpu_logits.len(), block.len() * vocab);
    for row in 0..block.len() {
        let cpu_row = &cpu_logits[row * vocab..(row + 1) * vocab];
        let gpu_row = &gpu_logits[row * vocab..(row + 1) * vocab];
        assert_eq!(
            argmax(cpu_row),
            argmax(gpu_row),
            "block row {row} top-1 disagreement"
        );
        let d = max_abs(cpu_row, gpu_row);
        assert!(d < 0.5, "block row {row} logit drift beyond the bar: {d}");
        assert!(
            gpu_row.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite()),
            "block row {row} produced non-finite logits"
        );
    }
    // The drafting pass wrote nothing: both sides still
    // hold exactly the injected set.
    assert_eq!(session.committed_len(), 8);

    // Round 2: a sparse commit (positions 16, 19, 23)
    // into a fresh pair, then a block at 24. The gaps are
    // the case a ring-addressed cache cannot state and
    // the position-addressed one must get right.
    let mut session2 = DflashSession::new(
        &backend,
        &cfg,
        &raw,
        Some(&emb_view),
        Some(&out_view),
        DflashSessionConfig { kv_capacity: 64 },
    )
    .expect("second session builds");
    let sparse = vec![16usize, 19, 23];
    let features2 = features_for(&cfg, &sparse);
    let mut cache2 = DflashCache::new(&cfg);
    cpu_model
        .inject(&mut cache2, &features2, &sparse)
        .expect("cpu sparse inject");
    session2
        .inject(&features2, &sparse)
        .expect("gpu sparse inject");
    assert_eq!(session2.positions(), sparse);
    let cpu_logits2 = cpu_model
        .forward_block(&cache2, &block, 24, &target)
        .expect("cpu sparse block");
    let gpu_logits2 = session2
        .forward_block(&block, 24)
        .expect("gpu sparse block");
    for row in 0..block.len() {
        let cpu_row = &cpu_logits2[row * vocab..(row + 1) * vocab];
        let gpu_row = &gpu_logits2[row * vocab..(row + 1) * vocab];
        assert_eq!(
            argmax(cpu_row),
            argmax(gpu_row),
            "sparse block row {row} top-1 disagreement"
        );
        let d = max_abs(cpu_row, gpu_row);
        assert!(d < 0.5, "sparse block row {row} drift beyond the bar: {d}");
    }

    // Refusals, in the CPU pass's own names and order.
    let err = session
        .forward_block(&[], 0)
        .expect_err("empty block refuses");
    assert!(matches!(err, DflashError::EmptyInput), "got {err}");
    let err = session
        .forward_block(&[1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 0)
        .expect_err("an over-long block refuses");
    assert!(matches!(err, DflashError::BlockTooLong { .. }), "got {err}");
    let err = session
        .forward_block(&[cfg.vocab_size], 0)
        .expect_err("an out-of-range token refuses");
    assert!(
        matches!(err, DflashError::TokenOutOfRange { .. }),
        "got {err}"
    );
    let err = session
        .inject(&features, &[3, 3])
        .expect_err("non-increasing positions refuse");
    assert!(
        matches!(err, DflashError::PositionConflict { .. }),
        "got {err}"
    );
    let err = session
        .inject(&features_for(&cfg, &[100]), &[100])
        .expect_err("a position past capacity refuses by name");
    assert!(
        matches!(&err, DflashError::StepFailed { step, .. } if *step == "dflash inject"),
        "got {err}"
    );

    // Reset returns the session to the empty-cache state.
    session.reset();
    assert_eq!(session.committed_len(), 0);
    assert!(session.positions().is_empty());
}

/// Session construction refusals that precede adapter
/// work where the code allows: a zero capacity and a
/// missing borrowed table refuse by name (both need the
/// backend handle, so they ride the same skip).
#[test]
fn dflash_session_construction_refusals() {
    let Some(backend) = backend_or_skip("dflash session construction test") else {
        return;
    };
    let cfg = fixture_cfg();
    let (tensors, emb_view, out_view) = fixture_tensors(&cfg);
    let raw = DflashRawWeights::load(&MapSource { tensors }, &cfg).expect("raw weights load");

    let err = DflashSession::new(
        &backend,
        &cfg,
        &raw,
        Some(&emb_view),
        Some(&out_view),
        DflashSessionConfig { kv_capacity: 0 },
    )
    .expect_err("zero capacity must refuse");
    assert!(matches!(err, DflashError::StepFailed { .. }), "got {err}");

    let err = DflashSession::new(
        &backend,
        &cfg,
        &raw,
        None,
        Some(&out_view),
        DflashSessionConfig::default(),
    )
    .expect_err("a missing borrowed embedding must refuse by name");
    assert!(
        matches!(
            &err,
            DflashError::MissingTargetTensors {
                which: "token_embd.weight"
            }
        ),
        "got {err}"
    );
}

/// The K17 rotate against `torch_math::rope` directly:
/// NEOX pairing, per-row positions from the array,
/// in place.
#[test]
fn k17_rotate_matches_torch_math() {
    let Some(backend) = backend_or_skip("k15 rotate test") else {
        return;
    };
    let ctx = backend.context();
    let pipeline = wgpu_compute::K17Pipeline::new(&ctx.device).expect("k15 pipelines build");
    let (rows, heads, head_dim) = (3usize, 2usize, 8usize);
    let positions = [0usize, 5, 127];
    let mut rng = Rng(0x207a7e);
    let input: Vec<f32> = (0..rows * heads * head_dim)
        .map(|_| rng.next_f32())
        .collect();
    let x = ctx.upload_f32("k15 rotate input", &input);
    let pos_bytes: Vec<u8> = positions
        .iter()
        .flat_map(|p| (*p as u32).to_le_bytes())
        .collect();
    let pos_buf = ctx.upload_bytes("k15 rotate positions", &pos_bytes);
    let inv_freq = pipeline.upload_inv_freq(ctx, head_dim, 10_000.0);
    let call = pipeline
        .prepare_rotate(ctx, &x, &pos_buf, &inv_freq, rows, heads, head_dim)
        .expect("rotate prepares");
    let mut encoder = ctx
        .device
        .create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor {
            label: Some("k15 rotate test"),
        });
    call.encode(&mut encoder);
    ctx.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
    let got = ctx
        .read_f32(&x, input.len())
        .expect("rotate output reads back");
    for (r, &pos) in positions.iter().enumerate() {
        for h in 0..heads {
            let row_in = &input[(r * heads + h) * head_dim..(r * heads + h + 1) * head_dim];
            let want = torch_math::rope(row_in, pos, 10_000.0, head_dim).expect("cpu rope");
            let got_row = &got[(r * heads + h) * head_dim..(r * heads + h + 1) * head_dim];
            let d = max_abs(&want, got_row);
            assert!(d < 1e-4, "rotate row {r} head {h} drift: {d}");
        }
    }
}

/// The capped block forward: the device runs the whole
/// block either way, so a capped readback must return the
/// full forward's exact prefix rows, the stats must count
/// only the values that actually crossed, and a cap that
/// is not a true prefix refuses by name before any device
/// work.
#[test]
fn dflash_session_capped_forward_returns_the_full_prefix() {
    let Some(backend) = backend_or_skip("dflash capped forward test") else {
        return;
    };
    let cfg = fixture_cfg();
    let (tensors, emb_view, out_view) = fixture_tensors(&cfg);
    let raw = DflashRawWeights::load(&MapSource { tensors }, &cfg).expect("raw weights load");
    let mut session = DflashSession::new(
        &backend,
        &cfg,
        &raw,
        Some(&emb_view),
        Some(&out_view),
        DflashSessionConfig { kv_capacity: 64 },
    )
    .expect("draft session builds");
    let positions: Vec<usize> = (0..8).collect();
    let features = features_for(&cfg, &positions);
    session.inject(&features, &positions).expect("gpu inject");

    let vocab = cfg.vocab_size as usize;
    let block: Vec<u32> = vec![3, 10, 17, cfg.mask_token_id];
    assert_eq!(block.len(), cfg.block_size as usize);
    let full = session.forward_block(&block, 8).expect("full block");
    assert_eq!(full.len(), block.len() * vocab);

    let mut expected_values = full.len() as u64;
    for cap in 1..=block.len() {
        let capped = session
            .forward_block_capped(&block, 8, cap)
            .expect("capped block");
        assert_eq!(capped.len(), cap * vocab, "cap {cap} length");
        assert_eq!(
            capped,
            full[..cap * vocab],
            "cap {cap} must be the full forward's exact prefix"
        );
        expected_values += capped.len() as u64;
    }
    let stats = session.stats();
    assert_eq!(stats.logits_values_read, expected_values);
    assert_eq!(stats.blocks, 1 + block.len() as u64);
    assert_eq!(stats.readbacks, stats.blocks);

    let err = session
        .forward_block_capped(&block, 8, 0)
        .expect_err("a zero cap refuses");
    assert!(
        matches!(&err, DflashError::StepFailed { step, .. } if *step == "dflash forward_block"),
        "got {err}"
    );
    let err = session
        .forward_block_capped(&block, 8, block.len() + 1)
        .expect_err("a cap past the block refuses");
    assert!(
        matches!(&err, DflashError::StepFailed { step, .. } if *step == "dflash forward_block"),
        "got {err}"
    );
}

/// Build the fixture draft session for the diag tests:
/// the parity fixture's raw weights and borrowed tables,
/// with positions 0..8 already injected.
fn diag_fixture_session<'a>(backend: &'a WgpuCompute, cfg: &DflashConfig) -> DflashSession<'a> {
    let (tensors, emb_view, out_view) = fixture_tensors(cfg);
    let raw = DflashRawWeights::load(&MapSource { tensors }, cfg).expect("raw weights load");
    let mut session = DflashSession::new(
        backend,
        cfg,
        &raw,
        Some(&emb_view),
        Some(&out_view),
        DflashSessionConfig { kv_capacity: 64 },
    )
    .expect("draft session builds");
    let positions: Vec<usize> = (0..8).collect();
    let features = features_for(cfg, &positions);
    session.inject(&features, &positions).expect("gpu inject");
    session
}

/// The diag capture wiring, timing arm (opt-in, the
/// resident tests' discipline): runs only when
/// `WGPU_COMPUTE_DIAG=timing` and `WGPU_COMPUTE_DIAG_OUT`
/// names the report file. A timing-mode draft session
/// carries the timing accumulator (its dispatches drain
/// and count), but the capture hooks stay inert: no
/// manifest begins, the block forward records no capture
/// rows, and the finish writes no capture sidecars.
#[test]
fn dflash_session_diag_timing_records_no_capture() {
    use wgpu_compute::DiagMode;

    let Some(out_path) = std::env::var_os(wgpu_compute::timestamps::DIAG_OUT_ENV) else {
        eprintln!("skipping dflash diag timing: DIAG_OUT is not set");
        return;
    };
    if DiagMode::from_env() != DiagMode::Timing {
        eprintln!("skipping dflash diag timing: WGPU_COMPUTE_DIAG is not `timing`");
        return;
    }
    let Some(backend) = backend_or_skip("dflash diag timing test") else {
        return;
    };
    if backend.context().diag_recorder().is_none() {
        eprintln!(
            "skipping dflash diag timing: timing requested but the device \
             granted no timestamp features, so no recorder exists"
        );
        return;
    }
    let out = std::path::PathBuf::from(out_path);
    // This opt-in run owns the prefix: clear any sidecars a
    // previous capture run left beside it, so their absence
    // below is this run's own doing.
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(wgpu_compute::manifest_sidecar_path(&out));
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(wgpu_compute::capture_sidecar_path(&out));

    let cfg = fixture_cfg();
    let mut session = diag_fixture_session(&backend, &cfg);
    assert!(
        session.diag_manifest_json().is_none(),
        "timing mode begins no capture manifest"
    );
    let block: Vec<u32> = vec![3, 10, 17, cfg.mask_token_id];
    session.forward_block(&block, 8).expect("gpu block");
    assert!(
        session.diag_dispatch_count() > 0,
        "the timing accumulator must drain the block's dispatches"
    );
    assert!(
        session.diag_capture_records().is_empty(),
        "timing mode records no capture rows, saw {:?}",
        session.diag_capture_records()
    );
    session.finish_diag_report();
    assert!(
        !wgpu_compute::manifest_sidecar_path(&out).exists(),
        "timing mode writes no manifest sidecar"
    );
    assert!(
        !wgpu_compute::capture_sidecar_path(&out).exists(),
        "timing mode writes no capture sidecar"
    );
}

/// The diag capture wiring, capture arm (opt-in, same
/// discipline): runs only when
/// `WGPU_COMPUTE_DIAG=capture` and `WGPU_COMPUTE_DIAG_OUT`
/// names the report file. The draft session begins its
/// manifest at construction (kind `dflash`, its depth and
/// block size), the block forward lands as exactly one
/// `block` capture record over the rows it read back, and
/// the finish leaves both sidecars.
#[test]
fn dflash_session_diag_capture_records_the_block() {
    use wgpu_compute::DiagMode;

    let Some(out_path) = std::env::var_os(wgpu_compute::timestamps::DIAG_OUT_ENV) else {
        eprintln!("skipping dflash diag capture: DIAG_OUT is not set");
        return;
    };
    if DiagMode::from_env() != DiagMode::Capture {
        eprintln!("skipping dflash diag capture: WGPU_COMPUTE_DIAG is not `capture`");
        return;
    }
    let Some(backend) = backend_or_skip("dflash diag capture test") else {
        return;
    };
    if backend.context().diag_recorder().is_none() {
        eprintln!(
            "skipping dflash diag capture: capture requested but the device \
             granted no timestamp features, so no recorder exists"
        );
        return;
    }
    let out = std::path::PathBuf::from(out_path);
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(wgpu_compute::manifest_sidecar_path(&out));
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(wgpu_compute::capture_sidecar_path(&out));

    let cfg = fixture_cfg();
    let mut session = diag_fixture_session(&backend, &cfg);
    let manifest = session
        .diag_manifest_json()
        .expect("capture mode begins the draft manifest at construction");
    assert!(
        manifest.contains("\"kind\":\"dflash\""),
        "manifest: {manifest}"
    );
    assert!(
        manifest.contains(&format!("\"depth\":\"{}\"", cfg.block_count)),
        "manifest: {manifest}"
    );
    assert!(
        manifest.contains(&format!("\"block_size\":\"{}\"", cfg.block_size)),
        "manifest: {manifest}"
    );
    assert!(
        session.diag_capture_records().is_empty(),
        "no forward yet, no capture records"
    );
    let block: Vec<u32> = vec![3, 10, 17, cfg.mask_token_id];
    session.forward_block(&block, 8).expect("gpu block");
    let records = session.diag_capture_records();
    assert_eq!(
        records.len(),
        1,
        "one block forward, one capture record: {records:?}"
    );
    assert_eq!(records[0].kind, wgpu_compute::CaptureRecord::KIND_BLOCK);
    assert_eq!(
        records[0].values,
        (block.len() * cfg.vocab_size as usize) as u64,
        "the fingerprint covers the rows the forward read back"
    );
    session.finish_diag_report();
    assert!(
        wgpu_compute::manifest_sidecar_path(&out).exists(),
        "capture mode writes the manifest sidecar"
    );
    let capture_text = std::fs::read_to_string(wgpu_compute::capture_sidecar_path(&out))
        .expect("capture mode writes the capture sidecar");
    let parsed = wgpu_compute::parse_capture_csv(&capture_text).expect("capture sidecar parses");
    assert_eq!(parsed.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(parsed[0].kind, wgpu_compute::CaptureRecord::KIND_BLOCK);
}

===== FILE: crates/wgpu-compute/tests/diag_capture.rs =====
//! The capture level's end-to-end contract through the
//! public API: two capture runs over the same values leave
//! sidecars that diff clean, and a run whose data changes at
//! one step diffs at exactly that step. No GPU: the capture
//! machinery is host-side by design (it fingerprints vectors
//! after their readback), so its whole contract is testable
//! here.

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use wgpu_compute::{
    diff_capture_records, diff_manifest_fields, manifest_fields, manifest_sidecar_path,
    parse_capture_csv, register_model_file, registered_model_file, CaptureRecord, DiagAccumulator,
    DiagMode, ModelFileInfo, RunManifest, MODEL_FINGERPRINT_METHOD,
};

fn sample_manifest() -> RunManifest {
    RunManifest {
        diag_mode: "capture".to_string(),
        build_version: "0.1.0".to_string(),
        git: "unknown".to_string(),
        adapter_name: "test adapter".to_string(),
        adapter_backend: "Vulkan".to_string(),
        adapter_device_type: "DiscreteGpu".to_string(),
        adapter_driver: "radv".to_string(),
        adapter_driver_info: "Mesa test".to_string(),
        resolved_config: vec![("mmv_max_rows".to_string(), "16".to_string())],
        // Stated explicitly so the process model registry
        // (another test in this binary registers one) can
        // never leak into these manifests at begin time.
        model: Some(ModelFileInfo {
            path: "model.gguf".to_string(),
            size_bytes: 123,
            fingerprint: "0123456789abcdef".to_string(),
            method: MODEL_FINGERPRINT_METHOD.to_string(),
        }),
        session: vec![("kind".to_string(), "resident".to_string())],
    }
}

/// Drive one capture run over fixed values and finish it,
/// returning the run's report prefix. `second` tweaks the
/// second forward's logits when set.
fn run_capture(dir: &Path, name: &str, second: Option<f32>) -> PathBuf {
    let prefix = dir.join(name);
    let mut acc = DiagAccumulator::with_mode(Some(prefix.clone()), DiagMode::Capture);
    acc.begin_manifest(sample_manifest());
    acc.record_forward(CaptureRecord::KIND_FORWARD, &[0.0, 1.0, 0.5])
        .expect("first forward");
    let second_logits = [2.0, second.unwrap_or(1.0), 0.25];
    acc.record_forward(CaptureRecord::KIND_FORWARD, &second_logits)
        .expect("second forward");
    acc.record_argmax(7, 1.5).expect("argmax");
    acc.record_spec_round(&[10, 11, 12, 13], 3).expect("round");
    assert!(acc.write_report(0));
    prefix
}

fn read_records(prefix: &Path) -> Vec<CaptureRecord> {
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(wgpu_compute::capture_sidecar_path(prefix))
        .expect("capture sidecar written");
    parse_capture_csv(&text).expect("capture sidecar parses")
}

fn test_dir(name: &str) -> PathBuf {
    let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
        "wgpu-compute-diag-capture-it-{name}-{}",
        std::process::id()
    ));
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).expect("temp dir");
    dir
}

#[test]
fn identical_capture_runs_diff_clean() {
    let dir = test_dir("identical");
    let a = run_capture(&dir, "a.csv", None);
    let b = run_capture(&dir, "b.csv", None);
    let diff = diff_capture_records(&read_records(&a), &read_records(&b));
    assert!(diff.identical(), "divergence: {:?}", diff.divergence);
    assert_eq!(diff.compared, 4);
    let a_manifest = std::fs::read_to_string(manifest_sidecar_path(&a)).expect("manifest a");
    let b_manifest = std::fs::read_to_string(manifest_sidecar_path(&b)).expect("manifest b");
    assert_eq!(
        a_manifest, b_manifest,
        "same inputs render the same manifest"
    );
    assert!(
        diff_manifest_fields(&manifest_fields(&a_manifest), &manifest_fields(&b_manifest))
            .is_empty()
    );
    let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
}

#[test]
fn a_changed_step_is_the_named_divergence() {
    let dir = test_dir("divergence");
    let a = run_capture(&dir, "a.csv", None);
    // The second forward's middle logit moves: record 0 must
    // still agree, record 1 must be the divergence, and its
    // field must be the fingerprint.
    let b = run_capture(&dir, "b.csv", Some(1.75));
    let diff = diff_capture_records(&read_records(&a), &read_records(&b));
    let div = diff.divergence.expect("the runs diverge");
    assert_eq!(div.seq, 1);
    assert_eq!(div.field, "hash");
    assert_eq!(diff.compared, 2, "record 0 agreed, record 1 decided it");
    let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
}

#[test]
fn model_registration_reaches_a_manifest_that_notes_nothing() {
    let dir = test_dir("registry");
    let model = dir.join("weights.gguf");
    std::fs::write(&model, b"GGUF registered for the manifest").expect("write model");
    let info = register_model_file(&model).expect("register");
    assert_eq!(info.size_bytes, 32);
    assert_eq!(registered_model_file(), Some(info.clone()));
    // A manifest begun with no model of its own picks the
    // registration up.
    let mut manifest = sample_manifest();
    manifest.model = None;
    let mut acc = DiagAccumulator::with_mode(None, DiagMode::Capture);
    acc.begin_manifest(manifest);
    let fields = manifest_fields(&acc.manifest_json().expect("manifest begun"));
    let path = fields
        .iter()
        .find(|(k, _)| k == "model.path")
        .map(|(_, v)| v.as_str());
    assert_eq!(path, Some(model.display().to_string().as_str()));
    let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
}
