===== FILE: mojo-engine/src/kernels/f32_gemv.mojo =====
# f32_gemv.mojo - the plain-float GEMV kernels (F32 and F16
# weight storage) for the Mojo/MAX engine. Lane A3 (straight
# ports), tuned in lane mojo-d3-gemv (Wave D, 2026-11-07).
#
# Real Glimmer tensors in this family (census 2026-10-29): the
# norm weights are F32 vectors (attn_norm, attn_q_norm and
# attn_k_norm [128], post_attention_norm, ffn_norm,
# post_ffw_norm, output_norm [6656]). Norms are consumed as
# vectors, not GEMV matrices, in the forward; this module is the
# family's GEMV citizen for any plain-float matrix the loader
# hands the engine (and the parity baseline the quantized
# kernels are checked against), plus the F16 storage variant:
# F16 appears in the file family the gguf loader serves
# (crates/gguf/src/dequant.rs F16 arm) and dequantizes exactly
# via kernels/dequant.f16_to_f32.
#
# F32 weights arrive as a Float32 list (host) / pointer (device);
# F16 weights arrive as raw bytes, two per element, little
# endian, exactly as stored. Every bad shape refuses by name.
#
# TUNED SHAPES (Wave D): the tuned-K1 lessons translated to
# plain floats, with opposite outcomes per dtype, both
# measured in cleared-card window 1 (bench note
# bench/mojo-d3-gemv-ladder-2026-11-07.md). The F16 kernel
# took the full translation and kept it: 2 rows per
# 128-thread workgroup as 8 groups of 16, each group
# striding the row in 256-element segments, one thread
# owning four quads per segment (quads t, t+16, t+32, t+48,
# so consecutive threads read consecutive quads), each quad
# arriving as two u32 words decoded through the bit-trick
# f16 route, activation quads loaded once per segment and
# shared by both rows, K1's segmented shuffle_xor butterfly
# plus a short shared-memory finish: 180.19 -> 717.94 GB/s
# median (3.98x the port). The same shape applied to F32
# measured 415.42 against the port's 432.13 GB/s median,
# slower in every rep - the port was already a clean
# streaming kernel and the vec4 segment shape bought
# nothing - so the F32 tuned iteration was REJECTED and
# f32_gemv_kernel below is the Wave A port, unchanged. The
# CPU twins below are byte-behaved and unchanged.
#
# Standalone usage mirrors k1_gemv:
#   f32_gemv <fixture_dir> [--dtype f32|f16] [--rows N]
#            [--cols N] [--iters N] [--warmup N] [--out PATH]
# Fixture files: weights_f32.bin (f32) or weights_f16.bin
# (f16), plus input_f32.bin. Defaults rows 64, cols 6656.

from std.time import perf_counter_ns
from std.sys import argv, exit
from max.gpu import thread_idx, block_idx, barrier
from max.gpu.host import DeviceContext
from max.gpu.memory import AddressSpace
from max.gpu.primitives.warp import shuffle_xor
from std.memory import stack_allocation, bitcast

from diag import log_debug
from kernels.dequant import f16_to_f32, note_loaded

comptime THREADS = 128
comptime F32_THREADS = 256
comptime ROWS_PER_WG = 2
comptime GROUP_THREADS = 16
comptime GROUPS = THREADS // GROUP_THREADS
comptime SEG_ELEMS = 256


def refuse(what: String, detail: String) -> None:
    print("REFUSAL f32_gemv_mojo: ", what, ": ", detail, sep="")
    exit(2)


def f16_to_f32_gpu(bits: UInt32) -> Float32:
    # Bit-trick f16 -> f32 for the GPU path, the same
    # construction k1_gemv.mojo carries (and the shipped wgpu
    # kernels use): normals rebias the exponent into f32 bits
    # directly, subnormals go through frac * 2^-24 (exact),
    # inf/NaN keep their class.
    var sign = (bits >> 15) & 1
    var exp = (bits >> 10) & 31
    var frac = bits & 1023
    if exp == 31:
        return bitcast[DType.float32, 1](
            SIMD[DType.uint32, 1]((sign << 31) | 0x7F800000 | (frac << 13))
        )
    if exp == 0:
        var v = Float32(frac) * Float32(5.9604644775390625e-08)
        if sign == 1:
            return -v
        return v
    return bitcast[DType.float32, 1](
        SIMD[DType.uint32, 1]((sign << 31) | ((exp + 112) << 23) | (frac << 13))
    )


def f16_quad_from_words(lo: UInt32, hi: UInt32) -> SIMD[DType.float32, 4]:
    # One F16 quad (4 halves, little endian across the two
    # words) decoded to f32, element order preserved.
    var out = SIMD[DType.float32, 4]()
    out[0] = f16_to_f32_gpu(lo & 0xFFFF)
    out[1] = f16_to_f32_gpu(lo >> 16)
    out[2] = f16_to_f32_gpu(hi & 0xFFFF)
    out[3] = f16_to_f32_gpu(hi >> 16)
    return out


def f32_gemv_kernel(
    w: Pointer[Float32, MutAnyOrigin],
    x: Pointer[Float32, MutAnyOrigin],
    y: Pointer[Float32, MutAnyOrigin],
    cols: Int32,
):
    # The Wave A straight port, restored after the tuned
    # iteration was measured and rejected (see the header):
    # one row per 256-thread workgroup, scalar loads, a
    # shared-memory tree reduction. On the synthetic timing
    # fixture the port's streaming shape beat the vec4
    # segment shape in every rep, so this kernel keeps it.
    var row = Int(block_idx.x)
    var tid = Int(thread_idx.x)
    var base = row * Int(cols)
    var shared = stack_allocation[
        F32_THREADS, Float32, address_space=AddressSpace.SHARED
    ]()
    var acc = Float32(0.0)
    var steps = Int(cols) // F32_THREADS
    for k in range(steps):
        var col = tid + k * F32_THREADS
        acc += w[unsafe_offset=base + col] * x[unsafe_offset=col]
    shared[unsafe_offset=tid] = acc
    barrier()
    var stride = F32_THREADS // 2
    while stride > 0:
        if tid < stride:
            shared[unsafe_offset=tid] = (
                shared[unsafe_offset=tid] + shared[unsafe_offset=tid + stride]
            )
        barrier()
        stride //= 2
    if tid == 0:
        y[unsafe_offset=row] = shared[unsafe_offset=0]


def f16_gemv_kernel(
    w: Pointer[UInt8, MutAnyOrigin],
    x: Pointer[Float32, MutAnyOrigin],
    y: Pointer[Float32, MutAnyOrigin],
    cols: Int32,
):
    # The F32 kernel's tuned shape over F16 storage: weights
    # arrive as raw half bytes, each quad as two u32 words
    # decoded by f16_quad_from_words. Quad element e sits at
    # byte 2e, a multiple of 8, so both words are aligned.
    var lane = Int(thread_idx.x)
    var group = lane // GROUP_THREADS
    var t = lane % GROUP_THREADS
    var row0 = Int(block_idx.x) * ROWS_PER_WG
    var w32 = w.unsafe_bitcast[UInt32]()
    var words_per_row = Int(cols) // 2
    var base0 = row0 * words_per_row
    var base1 = (row0 + 1) * words_per_row
    var shared = stack_allocation[
        ROWS_PER_WG * GROUPS, Float32, address_space=AddressSpace.SHARED
    ]()
    var acc0 = Float32(0.0)
    var acc1 = Float32(0.0)
    var segments = Int(cols) // SEG_ELEMS
    for seg in range(group, segments, GROUPS):
        var xb = seg * SEG_ELEMS + t * 4
        var xa = x.unsafe_load[width=4](xb)
        var xbq = x.unsafe_load[width=4](xb + 64)
        var xc = x.unsafe_load[width=4](xb + 128)
        var xd = x.unsafe_load[width=4](xb + 192)
        # Weight word-pair index of a quad: element e is half
        # e, word e // 2; a quad starts at an even half pair.
        var wb = seg * (SEG_ELEMS // 2) + t * 2
        acc0 += (
            f16_quad_from_words(
                w32.unsafe_load[width=1](base0 + wb),
                w32.unsafe_load[width=1](base0 + wb + 1),
            )
            * xa
        ).reduce_add()
        acc0 += (
            f16_quad_from_words(
                w32.unsafe_load[width=1](base0 + wb + 32),
                w32.unsafe_load[width=1](base0 + wb + 33),
            )
            * xbq
        ).reduce_add()
        acc0 += (
            f16_quad_from_words(
                w32.unsafe_load[width=1](base0 + wb + 64),
                w32.unsafe_load[width=1](base0 + wb + 65),
            )
            * xc
        ).reduce_add()
        acc0 += (
            f16_quad_from_words(
                w32.unsafe_load[width=1](base0 + wb + 96),
                w32.unsafe_load[width=1](base0 + wb + 97),
            )
            * xd
        ).reduce_add()
        acc1 += (
            f16_quad_from_words(
                w32.unsafe_load[width=1](base1 + wb),
                w32.unsafe_load[width=1](base1 + wb + 1),
            )
            * xa
        ).reduce_add()
        acc1 += (
            f16_quad_from_words(
                w32.unsafe_load[width=1](base1 + wb + 32),
                w32.unsafe_load[width=1](base1 + wb + 33),
            )
            * xbq
        ).reduce_add()
        acc1 += (
            f16_quad_from_words(
                w32.unsafe_load[width=1](base1 + wb + 64),
                w32.unsafe_load[width=1](base1 + wb + 65),
            )
            * xc
        ).reduce_add()
        acc1 += (
            f16_quad_from_words(
                w32.unsafe_load[width=1](base1 + wb + 96),
                w32.unsafe_load[width=1](base1 + wb + 97),
            )
            * xd
        ).reduce_add()
    acc0 += shuffle_xor(acc0, UInt32(1))
    acc0 += shuffle_xor(acc0, UInt32(2))
    acc0 += shuffle_xor(acc0, UInt32(4))
    acc0 += shuffle_xor(acc0, UInt32(8))
    acc1 += shuffle_xor(acc1, UInt32(1))
    acc1 += shuffle_xor(acc1, UInt32(2))
    acc1 += shuffle_xor(acc1, UInt32(4))
    acc1 += shuffle_xor(acc1, UInt32(8))
    if t == 0:
        shared[unsafe_offset=group] = acc0
        shared[unsafe_offset=GROUPS + group] = acc1
    barrier()
    if lane == 0:
        var s0 = Float32(0.0)
        var s1 = Float32(0.0)
        for g in range(GROUPS):
            s0 += shared[unsafe_offset=g]
            s1 += shared[unsafe_offset=GROUPS + g]
        y[unsafe_offset=row0] = s0
        y[unsafe_offset=row0 + 1] = s1


def check_shape(
    kind: String, w_len: Int, x_len: Int, rows: Int, cols: Int, elem_bytes: Int
) raises:
    if cols <= 0 or rows <= 0:
        raise Error(
            kind
            + "_bad_shape: rows and cols must be positive, got "
            + String(rows)
            + " x "
            + String(cols)
        )
    if w_len != rows * cols * elem_bytes:
        raise Error(
            kind
            + "_bad_shape: weights have "
            + String(w_len)
            + " storage units, expected "
            + String(rows * cols * elem_bytes)
        )
    if x_len != cols:
        raise Error(
            kind
            + "_bad_shape: input has "
            + String(x_len)
            + " f32, expected "
            + String(cols)
        )


def f32_gemv_cpu(
    w: List[Float32], x: List[Float32], rows: Int, cols: Int
) raises -> List[Float32]:
    """Plain F32 GEMV on the host. Raises a named error on a bad shape."""
    check_shape("f32_gemv_cpu", len(w), len(x), rows, cols, 1)
    var y = List[Float32](capacity=rows)
    y.resize(rows, Float32(0.0))
    for row in range(rows):
        var acc = Float32(0.0)
        for col in range(cols):
            acc += w[row * cols + col] * x[col]
        y[row] = acc
    _ = note_loaded("f32_gemv.cpu", rows, cols)
    return y^


def f16_gemv_cpu(
    w: List[UInt8], x: List[Float32], rows: Int, cols: Int
) raises -> List[Float32]:
    """F16-stored GEMV on the host: exact f16 decode + dot per row.

    Weights are raw file bytes, two per element. Raises a named
    error on a bad shape.
    """
    check_shape("f16_gemv_cpu", len(w), len(x), rows, cols, 2)
    var y = List[Float32](capacity=rows)
    y.resize(rows, Float32(0.0))
    for row in range(rows):
        var acc = Float32(0.0)
        for col in range(cols):
            var off = (row * cols + col) * 2
            var bits = UInt16(w[off]) | (UInt16(w[off + 1]) << 8)
            acc += f16_to_f32(bits) * x[col]
        y[row] = acc
    _ = note_loaded("f16_gemv.cpu", rows, cols)
    return y^


def read_file_exact(path: String, expected: Int) raises -> List[UInt8]:
    with open(path, "r") as f:
        var data = f.read_bytes(expected + 1)
        if len(data) != expected:
            print(
                "REFUSAL f32_gemv_mojo: fixture size mismatch: ",
                path,
                " has ",
                len(data),
                " readable bytes, expected ",
                expected,
                sep="",
            )
            exit(2)
        return data^


def arg_value(args: List[String], flag: String, default: String) -> String:
    for i in range(len(args) - 1):
        if args[i] == flag:
            return args[i + 1]
    return default


def main() raises:
    var args = List[String]()
    for a in argv():
        args.append(String(a))
    if len(args) < 2:
        refuse(
            "usage",
            (
                "f32_gemv <fixture_dir> [--dtype f32|f16] [--rows N]"
                " [--cols N] [--iters N] [--warmup N] [--out PATH]"
            ),
        )
    var fixture_dir = args[1]
    var dtype = arg_value(args, "--dtype", "f32")
    if dtype != "f32" and dtype != "f16":
        refuse("bad dtype", "expected f32 or f16, got " + dtype)
    var rows = Int(arg_value(args, "--rows", "64"))
    var cols = Int(arg_value(args, "--cols", "6656"))
    var iters = Int(arg_value(args, "--iters", "0"))
    var warmup = Int(arg_value(args, "--warmup", "3"))
    var out_path = arg_value(args, "--out", fixture_dir + "/mojo_out_f32.bin")
    if cols % SEG_ELEMS != 0:
        refuse(
            "bad shape",
            "cols must be a multiple of the 256-element segment, got "
            + String(cols),
        )
    if dtype == "f16" and rows % ROWS_PER_WG != 0:
        refuse(
            "bad shape",
            "rows must be a multiple of the 2-row workgroup tile, got "
            + String(rows),
        )
    var elem_bytes = 4 if dtype == "f32" else 2
    var weights_bytes = rows * cols * elem_bytes
    var wname = "/weights_f32.bin" if dtype == "f32" else "/weights_f16.bin"
    var w_host = read_file_exact(fixture_dir + wname, weights_bytes)
    var x_host = read_file_exact(fixture_dir + "/input_f32.bin", cols * 4)
    _ = log_debug(
        "f32_gemv.load",
        "dtype "
        + dtype
        + ", weights "
        + String(weights_bytes)
        + " bytes, input "
        + String(cols)
        + " f32",
    )

    var ctx = DeviceContext()
    var x_dev = ctx.enqueue_create_buffer[DType.float32](cols)
    var o_dev = ctx.enqueue_create_buffer[DType.float32](rows)
    var x_src = ctx.enqueue_create_host_buffer[DType.float32](cols)
    for i in range(cols):
        var p = x_host.unsafe_ptr().unsafe_bitcast[Float32]()
        x_src[i] = p[unsafe_offset=i]
    ctx.enqueue_copy(src_buf=x_src, dst_buf=x_dev)

    if dtype == "f32":
        var w_dev = ctx.enqueue_create_buffer[DType.float32](rows * cols)
        var w_src = ctx.enqueue_create_host_buffer[DType.float32](rows * cols)
        var wp = w_host.unsafe_ptr().unsafe_bitcast[Float32]()
        for i in range(rows * cols):
            w_src[i] = wp[unsafe_offset=i]
        ctx.enqueue_copy(src_buf=w_src, dst_buf=w_dev)
        ctx.enqueue_function[f32_gemv_kernel](
            w_dev,
            x_dev,
            o_dev,
            Int32(cols),
            grid_dim=rows,
            block_dim=F32_THREADS,
        )
        ctx.synchronize()
        if iters > 0:
            for _ in range(warmup):
                ctx.enqueue_function[f32_gemv_kernel](
                    w_dev,
                    x_dev,
                    o_dev,
                    Int32(cols),
                    grid_dim=rows,
                    block_dim=F32_THREADS,
                )
            ctx.synchronize()
            var t0 = perf_counter_ns()
            for _ in range(iters):
                ctx.enqueue_function[f32_gemv_kernel](
                    w_dev,
                    x_dev,
                    o_dev,
                    Int32(cols),
                    grid_dim=rows,
                    block_dim=F32_THREADS,
                )
            ctx.synchronize()
            var elapsed = Float64(perf_counter_ns() - t0) / 1.0e9
            var gbs = Float64(weights_bytes) * Float64(iters) / elapsed / 1.0e9
            print("MOJO_TIMING iters", iters, "GB/s", gbs)
    else:
        var w_dev = ctx.enqueue_create_buffer[DType.uint8](weights_bytes)
        var w_src = ctx.enqueue_create_host_buffer[DType.uint8](weights_bytes)
        for i in range(weights_bytes):
            w_src[i] = w_host[i]
        ctx.enqueue_copy(src_buf=w_src, dst_buf=w_dev)
        ctx.enqueue_function[f16_gemv_kernel](
            w_dev,
            x_dev,
            o_dev,
            Int32(cols),
            grid_dim=rows // ROWS_PER_WG,
            block_dim=THREADS,
        )
        ctx.synchronize()
        if iters > 0:
            for _ in range(warmup):
                ctx.enqueue_function[f16_gemv_kernel](
                    w_dev,
                    x_dev,
                    o_dev,
                    Int32(cols),
                    grid_dim=rows // ROWS_PER_WG,
                    block_dim=THREADS,
                )
            ctx.synchronize()
            var t0 = perf_counter_ns()
            for _ in range(iters):
                ctx.enqueue_function[f16_gemv_kernel](
                    w_dev,
                    x_dev,
                    o_dev,
                    Int32(cols),
                    grid_dim=rows // ROWS_PER_WG,
                    block_dim=THREADS,
                )
            ctx.synchronize()
            var elapsed = Float64(perf_counter_ns() - t0) / 1.0e9
            var gbs = Float64(weights_bytes) * Float64(iters) / elapsed / 1.0e9
            print("MOJO_TIMING iters", iters, "GB/s", gbs)
    _ = log_debug("f32_gemv.run", "correctness launch done")

    var o_host = ctx.enqueue_create_host_buffer[DType.float32](rows)
    ctx.enqueue_copy(src_buf=o_dev, dst_buf=o_host)
    ctx.synchronize()
    var out_bytes = List[UInt8](capacity=rows * 4)
    out_bytes.resize(rows * 4, UInt8(0))
    var op = out_bytes.unsafe_ptr().unsafe_bitcast[Float32]()
    for i in range(rows):
        op[unsafe_offset=i] = o_host[i]
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        f.write_bytes(out_bytes)
    print("MOJO_OUT wrote", out_path, rows, "f32")

===== END FILE: mojo-engine/src/kernels/f32_gemv.mojo =====

===== FILE: mojo-engine/src/kernels/gemm.mojo =====
# gemm.mojo - the batched (matrix-matrix) projection kernels
# for PREFILL, Wave D Lane D1 (mojo-engine/src/kernels/).
#
# Why this module exists: through Wave C, prefill ran the GEMV
# family once per prompt row - one launch per projection per
# position, the weight stream re-read from the card for every
# row. A prefill projection is really one matrix-matrix
# product: many prompt rows against the SAME resident weight
# matrix. This module is that product, per quantized shape the
# GPU layer dispatches for layer projections (the Wave A
# census: Q4_K 365 tensors, Q6_K 52, Q5_K 1 - the head - F32
# norms-as-vectors plus any F32 matrix slot; F16 has zero
# weight tensors in Glimmer and the batch path refuses it by
# name - single rows keep the GEMV path, f16_gemv_kernel).
# Decode is untouched: it stays on the GEMV family.
#
# Layouts (the whole contract, stated once): the activation
# batch X is flat row-major [batch][cols] (one prompt row per
# batch element, contiguous), the weight matrix W is the
# slot's raw storage exactly as the GEMVs consume it
# ([rows][cols], row-major, quantized super-blocks inline),
# and the output Y is flat row-major [batch][rows], so batch
# element b's output row is Y[b*rows .. (b+1)*rows) - the same
# row the GEMV would have produced for X[b*cols ..].
# Dequant is IN-KERNEL and identical to the GEMVs': Q4_K uses
# k1_gemv.mojo's own unpack/scale helpers and the
# d*sc*dot(q,x) - dmin*m*sum(x) form; Q6_K / Q5_K use
# kernels/dequant.mojo's per-element helpers, the same ones
# q6k_gemv / q5k_gemv call; F32 is the plain product.
#
# Structures, in the order the lane evaluated them (the bench
# note bench/mojo-engine-wave-d1-gemm-2026-11-07.md records
# every iteration's numbers; correctness gate FIRST each time):
#   (1) MAX's own kernel library matmul: NO FIT, recorded in
#       the bench note. In MAX 26.7 the only quantized matmul
#       surface is the Python graph op max.graph.ops.qmatmul
#       (Q4_K / Q6_K encodings only, no Q5_K), which lives in
#       the MAX graph/pipeline world: it takes TensorValues in
#       MAX's repacked quantized layout, QUANTIZES the lhs
#       activations to the rhs encoding before the product
#       (not this engine's f32-activation semantics, and not
#       the K1 accumulation form the Wave A bar is stated
#       against), and is not callable from Mojo kernel code -
#       no Mojo-side matmul module is importable in this
#       toolchain (probed: max.kernels.matmul, max.nn,
#       kernels.matmul all fail to resolve). Adopting it would
#       mean rebuilding the forward inside MAX graphs, a
#       different engine, not a prefill path for this one.
#   (2) *_gemm_kernel: the straightforward batched form. One
#       workgroup per (batch element, output row) - the GEMV
#       workgroup body verbatim with batch offsets - launched
#       ONCE for the whole batch. The weight stream is shared
#       across batch elements through the card's caches (the
#       launches are one grid, back to back), never re-uploaded.
#   (3) *_gemm_tiled_kernel: a register-tiled form. One
#       workgroup owns ONE output row for a tile of
#       BATCH_TILE batch elements: each weight element (or
#       Q4_K super-block header + packed quads) is loaded and
#       dequantized ONCE per workgroup and applied to every
#       batch element in the tile, so the weight stream is
#       read once per tile instead of once per row. The host
#       picks (3) at or above a configured batch size and (2)
#       below it (src/config.mojo: MOJO_ENGINE_GEMM_TILED_MIN_BATCH).
#
# The CPU twins below are the parity reference: each one runs
# the corresponding GEMV CPU twin per batch row on that row's
# slice, so a CPU-twin row is bit-identical to the GEMV path's
# row by construction, and the GPU kernels are measured
# against these twins under the Wave A bars (stated per shape
# in tests/server_proof_gemm.mojo).
#
# Named refusals: gemm_bad_shape (non-positive dims, cols not
# a multiple of the shape's kernel step, Q4_K rows not a
# multiple of the K1 workgroup tile, weight/input length
# mismatches). Diag seam: phase `gemm`, via src/diag.mojo.

from max.gpu import thread_idx, block_idx, block_dim, barrier
from max.gpu.memory import AddressSpace
from max.gpu.primitives.warp import shuffle_xor
from std.memory import stack_allocation

from diag import log_debug
from kernels.dequant import (
    q6k_element_ptr,
    q5k_element_ptr,
    f16_to_f32 as dequant_f16_to_f32,
)
from kernels.k1_gemv import (
    k1_gemv_cpu,
    f16_to_f32_gpu,
    unpack4_f32,
    unpack_q_f32,
    THREADS as K1_THREADS,
    ROWS_PER_WG as K1_ROWS_PER_WG,
    GROUP_THREADS as K1_GROUP_THREADS,
    GROUPS as K1_GROUPS,
    SB_ELEMS as K1_SB_ELEMS,
    SB_WORDS as K1_SB_WORDS,
)
from kernels.q6k_gemv import q6k_gemv_cpu, THREADS as Q6_THREADS
from kernels.q5k_gemv import q5k_gemv_cpu, THREADS as Q5_THREADS
from kernels.f32_gemv import f32_gemv_cpu, THREADS as F_THREADS

comptime BATCH_TILE = 4
comptime SB_ELEMS = 256
comptime Q6_SB_BYTES = 210
comptime Q5_SB_BYTES = 176
comptime Q4_SB_BYTES = 144


# ---- pure shape helpers (VM-testable, no device) -------------


def check_gemm_dims(name: String, batch: Int, rows: Int, cols: Int) raises:
    """The dims every GEMM shape shares: all positive."""
    if batch <= 0 or rows <= 0 or cols <= 0:
        raise Error(
            "gemm_bad_shape: "
            + name
            + " got batch/rows/cols "
            + String(batch)
            + "/"
            + String(rows)
            + "/"
            + String(cols)
            + ", all must be positive"
        )


def gemm_plain_grid(rows: Int, batch: Int) raises -> Int:
    """Workgroups for a structure-(2) launch over byte/F32
    shapes: one per (output row, batch element)."""
    if rows <= 0 or batch <= 0:
        raise Error(
            "gemm_bad_shape: plain grid needs positive rows/batch, got "
            + String(rows)
            + "/"
            + String(batch)
        )
    return rows * batch


def gemm_tiled_grid(rows: Int, batch: Int) raises -> Int:
    """Workgroups for a structure-(3) launch: one per
    (output row, batch tile of BATCH_TILE)."""
    if rows <= 0 or batch <= 0:
        raise Error(
            "gemm_bad_shape: tiled grid needs positive rows/batch, got "
            + String(rows)
            + "/"
            + String(batch)
        )
    return rows * ((batch + BATCH_TILE - 1) // BATCH_TILE)


def gemm_k1_grid(rows: Int, batch: Int) raises -> Int:
    """Workgroups for a structure-(2) K1 launch: the K1
    workgroup covers K1_ROWS_PER_WG output rows of ONE batch
    element, so rows must be a multiple of the tile (the GEMV
    host rule, kept)."""
    if batch <= 0 or rows <= 0 or rows % K1_ROWS_PER_WG != 0:
        raise Error(
            "gemm_bad_shape: k1 grid needs rows a multiple of "
            + String(K1_ROWS_PER_WG)
            + " and positive batch, got rows="
            + String(rows)
            + " batch="
            + String(batch)
        )
    return (rows // K1_ROWS_PER_WG) * batch


def gemm_k1_tiled_grid(rows: Int, batch: Int) raises -> Int:
    """Workgroups for a structure-(3) K1 launch: one workgroup
    covers K1_ROWS_PER_WG output rows for a whole batch tile."""
    if batch <= 0 or rows <= 0 or rows % K1_ROWS_PER_WG != 0:
        raise Error(
            "gemm_bad_shape: k1 tiled grid needs rows a multiple of "
            + String(K1_ROWS_PER_WG)
            + " and positive batch, got rows="
            + String(rows)
            + " batch="
            + String(batch)
        )
    return (rows // K1_ROWS_PER_WG) * ((batch + BATCH_TILE - 1) // BATCH_TILE)


def _slice_f32(x: List[Float32], off: Int, n: Int) -> List[Float32]:
    var out = List[Float32](capacity=n)
    out.resize(n, Float32(0.0))
    for i in range(n):
        out[i] = x[off + i]
    return out^


def _place_f32(mut y: List[Float32], off: Int, row: List[Float32]):
    for i in range(len(row)):
        y[off + i] = row[i]


# ---- CPU twins (parity reference; GEMV twin per batch row) ---


def q4k_gemm_cpu(
    w: List[UInt8], x: List[Float32], batch: Int, rows: Int, cols: Int
) raises -> List[Float32]:
    """Q4_K GEMM on the host: k1_gemv_cpu per batch row."""
    check_gemm_dims("q4k_gemm", batch, rows, cols)
    if cols % SB_ELEMS != 0:
        raise Error(
            "gemm_bad_shape: q4k cols must be a multiple of 256, got "
            + String(cols)
        )
    if len(x) != batch * cols:
        raise Error(
            "gemm_bad_shape: q4k input has "
            + String(len(x))
            + " f32, expected batch*cols "
            + String(batch * cols)
        )
    var y = List[Float32](capacity=batch * rows)
    y.resize(batch * rows, Float32(0.0))
    for b in range(batch):
        var row = k1_gemv_cpu(w, _slice_f32(x, b * cols, cols), rows, cols)
        _place_f32(y, b * rows, row)
    _ = log_debug(
        "gemm", "q4k cpu batch=" + String(batch) + " rows=" + String(rows)
    )
    return y^


def q6k_gemm_cpu(
    w: List[UInt8], x: List[Float32], batch: Int, rows: Int, cols: Int
) raises -> List[Float32]:
    """Q6_K GEMM on the host: q6k_gemv_cpu per batch row."""
    check_gemm_dims("q6k_gemm", batch, rows, cols)
    if cols % SB_ELEMS != 0:
        raise Error(
            "gemm_bad_shape: q6k cols must be a multiple of 256, got "
            + String(cols)
        )
    if len(x) != batch * cols:
        raise Error(
            "gemm_bad_shape: q6k input has "
            + String(len(x))
            + " f32, expected batch*cols "
            + String(batch * cols)
        )
    var y = List[Float32](capacity=batch * rows)
    y.resize(batch * rows, Float32(0.0))
    for b in range(batch):
        var row = q6k_gemv_cpu(w, _slice_f32(x, b * cols, cols), rows, cols)
        _place_f32(y, b * rows, row)
    _ = log_debug(
        "gemm", "q6k cpu batch=" + String(batch) + " rows=" + String(rows)
    )
    return y^


def q5k_gemm_cpu(
    w: List[UInt8], x: List[Float32], batch: Int, rows: Int, cols: Int
) raises -> List[Float32]:
    """Q5_K GEMM on the host: q5k_gemv_cpu per batch row."""

    if cols % SB_ELEMS != 0:
        raise Error(
            "gemm_bad_shape: q5k cols must be a multiple of 256, got "

        )
    if len(x) != batch * cols:

            + " f32, expected batch*cols "

        "gemm", "q5k cpu batch=" + String(batch) + " rows=" + String(rows)
    )

def f32_gemm_cpu(
    w: List[Float32], x: List[Float32], batch: Int, rows: Int, cols: Int
) raises -> List[Float32]:
    """F32 GEMM on the host: f32_gemv_cpu per batch row."""
    check_gemm_dims("f32_gemm", batch, rows, cols)
    if len(w) != rows * cols:
        raise Error(
            "gemm_bad_shape: f32 weights have "
            + String(len(w))
            + " f32, expected rows*cols "
            + String(rows * cols)
        )
    if len(x) != batch * cols:
        raise Error(
            "gemm_bad_shape: f32 input has "
            + String(len(x))
            + " f32, expected batch*cols "
            + String(batch * cols)
        )
    var y = List[Float32](capacity=batch * rows)
    y.resize(batch * rows, Float32(0.0))
    for b in range(batch):
        var row = f32_gemv_cpu(w, _slice_f32(x, b * cols, cols), rows, cols)
        _place_f32(y, b * rows, row)
    _ = log_debug(
        "gemm", "f32 cpu batch=" + String(batch) + " rows=" + String(rows)
    )
    return y^


# ---- structure (2): batched GEMV workgroups, one launch ------
#
# Grid is a flat gemm_plain_grid / gemm_k1_grid count; the
# block index decomposes as idx = row * batch + b for the
# 256-thread shapes (same-row workgroups adjacent, so the
# weight stream shared across the batch sits in adjacent
# launches for the cache), and idx = wg * batch + b for K1.


def q6k_gemm_kernel(
    w: Pointer[UInt8, MutAnyOrigin],
    x: Pointer[Float32, MutAnyOrigin],
    y: Pointer[Float32, MutAnyOrigin],
    cols: Int32,
    batch: Int32,
    rows: Int32,
):
    var idx = Int(block_idx.x)
    var row = idx // Int(batch)
    var b = idx % Int(batch)
    var tid = Int(thread_idx.x)
    var row_bytes = (Int(cols) // SB_ELEMS) * Q6_SB_BYTES
    var base = row * row_bytes
    var xbase = b * Int(cols)
    var shared = stack_allocation[
        Q6_THREADS, Float32, address_space=AddressSpace.SHARED
    ]()
    var acc = Float32(0.0)
    var steps = Int(cols) // Q6_THREADS
    for k in range(steps):
        var col = tid + k * Q6_THREADS
        var sb_off = base + (col >> 8) * Q6_SB_BYTES
        var val = q6k_element_ptr(w, sb_off, col & 255)
        acc += val * x[unsafe_offset=xbase + col]
    shared[unsafe_offset=tid] = acc
    barrier()
    var stride = Q6_THREADS // 2
    while stride > 0:
        if tid < stride:
            shared[unsafe_offset=tid] = (
                shared[unsafe_offset=tid] + shared[unsafe_offset=tid + stride]
            )
        barrier()
        stride //= 2
    if tid == 0:
        y[unsafe_offset=b * Int(rows) + row] = shared[unsafe_offset=0]


def q5k_gemm_kernel(
    w: Pointer[UInt8, MutAnyOrigin],
    x: Pointer[Float32, MutAnyOrigin],
    y: Pointer[Float32, MutAnyOrigin],
    cols: Int32,
    batch: Int32,
    rows: Int32,
):
    var idx = Int(block_idx.x)
    var row = idx // Int(batch)
    var b = idx % Int(batch)
    var tid = Int(thread_idx.x)
    var row_bytes = (Int(cols) // SB_ELEMS) * Q5_SB_BYTES
    var base = row * row_bytes
    var xbase = b * Int(cols)
    var shared = stack_allocation[
        Q5_THREADS, Float32, address_space=AddressSpace.SHARED
    ]()
    var acc = Float32(0.0)
    var steps = Int(cols) // Q5_THREADS
    for k in range(steps):
        var col = tid + k * Q5_THREADS
        var sb_off = base + (col >> 8) * Q5_SB_BYTES
        var val = q5k_element_ptr(w, sb_off, col & 255)
        acc += val * x[unsafe_offset=xbase + col]
    shared[unsafe_offset=tid] = acc
    barrier()
    var stride = Q5_THREADS // 2
    while stride > 0:
        if tid < stride:
            shared[unsafe_offset=tid] = (
                shared[unsafe_offset=tid] + shared[unsafe_offset=tid + stride]
            )
        barrier()
        stride //= 2
    if tid == 0:
        y[unsafe_offset=b * Int(rows) + row] = shared[unsafe_offset=0]


def f32_gemm_kernel(
    w: Pointer[Float32, MutAnyOrigin],
    x: Pointer[Float32, MutAnyOrigin],
    y: Pointer[Float32, MutAnyOrigin],
    cols: Int32,
    batch: Int32,
    rows: Int32,
):
    var idx = Int(block_idx.x)
    var row = idx // Int(batch)
    var b = idx % Int(batch)
    var tid = Int(thread_idx.x)
    var base = row * Int(cols)
    var xbase = b * Int(cols)
    var shared = stack_allocation[
        F_THREADS, Float32, address_space=AddressSpace.SHARED
    ]()
    var acc = Float32(0.0)
    var steps = Int(cols) // F_THREADS
    for k in range(steps):
        var col = tid + k * F_THREADS
        acc += w[unsafe_offset=base + col] * x[unsafe_offset=xbase + col]
    shared[unsafe_offset=tid] = acc
    barrier()
    var stride = F_THREADS // 2
    while stride > 0:
        if tid < stride:
            shared[unsafe_offset=tid] = (
                shared[unsafe_offset=tid] + shared[unsafe_offset=tid + stride]
            )
        barrier()
        stride //= 2
    if tid == 0:
        y[unsafe_offset=b * Int(rows) + row] = shared[unsafe_offset=0]


def k1_gemm_kernel(
    w: Pointer[UInt8, MutAnyOrigin],
    x: Pointer[Float32, MutAnyOrigin],
    y: Pointer[Float32, MutAnyOrigin],
    cols: Int32,
    batch: Int32,
    rows: Int32,
):
    # The K1 r2sg workgroup body (k1_gemv_kernel) verbatim, with
    # the activation stream offset by the batch element and the
    # two output rows written into that element's Y row block.
    var idx = Int(block_idx.x)
    var wg = idx // Int(batch)
    var b = idx % Int(batch)
    var lane = Int(thread_idx.x)
    var group = lane // K1_GROUP_THREADS
    var t = lane % K1_GROUP_THREADS
    var half = t // 8
    var w0_off = 4 + 8 * half + (t % 8)
    var yv = 16 * half + (t % 8)
    var blocks_per_row = Int(cols) // K1_SB_ELEMS
    var row0 = wg * K1_ROWS_PER_WG
    var xbase = b * Int(cols)
    var ybase = b * Int(rows)
    var w32 = w.unsafe_bitcast[UInt32]()
    var shared = stack_allocation[
        K1_ROWS_PER_WG * K1_GROUPS, Float32, address_space=AddressSpace.SHARED
    ]()
    var acc0 = Float32(0.0)
    var acc1 = Float32(0.0)
    for blk in range(group, blocks_per_row, K1_GROUPS):
        var xb = xbase + blk * K1_SB_ELEMS + yv * 4
        var xa = x.unsafe_load[width=4](xb)
        var xbq = x.unsafe_load[width=4](xb + 32)
        var xc = x.unsafe_load[width=4](xb + 128)
        var xd = x.unsafe_load[width=4](xb + 160)
        var sa = xa.reduce_add()
        var sb = xbq.reduce_add()
        var sc_ = xc.reduce_add()
        var sd = xd.reduce_add()
        var bw0 = (row0 * blocks_per_row + blk) * K1_SB_WORDS
        var hdr0 = w32.unsafe_load[width=4](bw0)
        var hw0 = hdr0[0]
        var d0 = f16_to_f32_gpu(hw0 & 0xFFFF)
        var dmin0 = f16_to_f32_gpu(hw0 >> 16)
        var s16_0 = (hdr0[1] >> UInt32(16 * half)) & 0xFFFF
        var m16_0 = (hdr0[2] >> UInt32(16 * half)) & 0xFFFF
        var h16_0 = (hdr0[3] >> UInt32(16 * half)) & 0xFFFF
        var lo0 = (m16_0 << 16) | s16_0
        var sc_lo0 = unpack4_f32(lo0 & 0x3F3F3F3F)
        var hi0 = (((h16_0 << 12) | h16_0) & 0x0F0F0F0F) | (
            (lo0 & 0xC0C0C0C0) >> 2
        )
        var sc_hi0 = unpack4_f32(hi0)
        var q0 = unpack_q_f32(w32.unsafe_load[width=1](bw0 + w0_off))
        var q1 = unpack_q_f32(w32.unsafe_load[width=1](bw0 + w0_off + 16))
        acc0 += d0 * (
            sc_lo0[0] * (q0[0] * xa).reduce_add()
            + sc_lo0[1] * (q0[1] * xbq).reduce_add()
            + sc_hi0[0] * (q1[0] * xc).reduce_add()
            + sc_hi0[1] * (q1[1] * xd).reduce_add()
        ) - dmin0 * (
            sc_lo0[2] * sa + sc_lo0[3] * sb + sc_hi0[2] * sc_ + sc_hi0[3] * sd
        )
        var bw1 = ((row0 + 1) * blocks_per_row + blk) * K1_SB_WORDS
        var hdr1 = w32.unsafe_load[width=4](bw1)
        var hw1 = hdr1[0]
        var d1 = f16_to_f32_gpu(hw1 & 0xFFFF)
        var dmin1 = f16_to_f32_gpu(hw1 >> 16)
        var s16_1 = (hdr1[1] >> UInt32(16 * half)) & 0xFFFF
        var m16_1 = (hdr1[2] >> UInt32(16 * half)) & 0xFFFF
        var h16_1 = (hdr1[3] >> UInt32(16 * half)) & 0xFFFF
        var lo1 = (m16_1 << 16) | s16_1
        var sc_lo1 = unpack4_f32(lo1 & 0x3F3F3F3F)
        var hi1 = (((h16_1 << 12) | h16_1) & 0x0F0F0F0F) | (
            (lo1 & 0xC0C0C0C0) >> 2
        )
        var sc_hi1 = unpack4_f32(hi1)
        var q2 = unpack_q_f32(w32.unsafe_load[width=1](bw1 + w0_off))
        var q3 = unpack_q_f32(w32.unsafe_load[width=1](bw1 + w0_off + 16))
        acc1 += d1 * (
            sc_lo1[0] * (q2[0] * xa).reduce_add()
            + sc_lo1[1] * (q2[1] * xbq).reduce_add()
            + sc_hi1[0] * (q3[0] * xc).reduce_add()
            + sc_hi1[1] * (q3[1] * xd).reduce_add()
        ) - dmin1 * (
            sc_lo1[2] * sa + sc_lo1[3] * sb + sc_hi1[2] * sc_ + sc_hi1[3] * sd
        )
    acc0 += shuffle_xor(acc0, UInt32(1))
    acc0 += shuffle_xor(acc0, UInt32(2))
    acc0 += shuffle_xor(acc0, UInt32(4))
    acc0 += shuffle_xor(acc0, UInt32(8))
    acc1 += shuffle_xor(acc1, UInt32(1))
    acc1 += shuffle_xor(acc1, UInt32(2))
    acc1 += shuffle_xor(acc1, UInt32(4))
    acc1 += shuffle_xor(acc1, UInt32(8))
    if t == 0:
        shared[unsafe_offset=group] = acc0
        shared[unsafe_offset=K1_GROUPS + group] = acc1
    barrier()
    if lane == 0:
        var s0 = Float32(0.0)
        var s1 = Float32(0.0)
        for g in range(K1_GROUPS):
            s0 += shared[unsafe_offset=g]
            s1 += shared[unsafe_offset=K1_GROUPS + g]
        y[unsafe_offset=ybase + row0] = s0
        y[unsafe_offset=ybase + row0 + 1] = s1


# ---- structure (3): register batch-tiled kernels -------------
#
# One workgroup owns ONE output row (K1: the usual row pair)
# for a tile of BATCH_TILE consecutive batch elements. Each
# weight value is loaded and dequantized once per workgroup
# and applied to every element of the tile from registers, so
# the weight stream crosses the memory system once per tile
# instead of once per batch element. Grid is the flat
# gemm_tiled_grid / gemm_k1_tiled_grid count, decomposed as
# idx = row * tiles + tile (K1: wg * tiles + tile). A partial
# final tile is handled by clamping the element index and
# zeroing its contributions (n_in_tile).


def q6k_gemm_tiled_kernel(
    w: Pointer[UInt8, MutAnyOrigin],
    x: Pointer[Float32, MutAnyOrigin],
    y: Pointer[Float32, MutAnyOrigin],
    cols: Int32,
    batch: Int32,
    rows: Int32,
):
    var tiles = (Int(batch) + BATCH_TILE - 1) // BATCH_TILE
    var idx = Int(block_idx.x)
    var row = idx // tiles
    var b0 = (idx % tiles) * BATCH_TILE
    var n_in = BATCH_TILE
    if b0 + n_in > Int(batch):
        n_in = Int(batch) - b0
    var tid = Int(thread_idx.x)
    var row_bytes = (Int(cols) // SB_ELEMS) * Q6_SB_BYTES
    var base = row * row_bytes
    var accs = stack_allocation[BATCH_TILE, Float32]()
    for j in range(BATCH_TILE):
        accs[unsafe_offset=j] = Float32(0.0)
    var steps = Int(cols) // Q6_THREADS
    for k in range(steps):
        var col = tid + k * Q6_THREADS
        var sb_off = base + (col >> 8) * Q6_SB_BYTES
        var val = q6k_element_ptr(w, sb_off, col & 255)
        for j in range(BATCH_TILE):
            if j < n_in:
                accs[unsafe_offset=j] = (
                    accs[unsafe_offset=j]
                    + val * x[unsafe_offset=(b0 + j) * Int(cols) + col]
                )
    var shared = stack_allocation[
        BATCH_TILE * Q6_THREADS, Float32, address_space=AddressSpace.SHARED
    ]()
    for j in range(BATCH_TILE):
        shared[unsafe_offset=j * Q6_THREADS + tid] = accs[unsafe_offset=j]
    barrier()
    var stride = Q6_THREADS // 2
    while stride > 0:
        if tid < stride:
            for j in range(BATCH_TILE):
                shared[unsafe_offset=j * Q6_THREADS + tid] = (
                    shared[unsafe_offset=j * Q6_THREADS + tid]
                    + shared[unsafe_offset=j * Q6_THREADS + tid + stride]
                )
        barrier()
        stride //= 2
    if tid == 0:
        for j in range(BATCH_TILE):
            if j < n_in:
                y[unsafe_offset=(b0 + j) * Int(rows) + row] = shared[
                    unsafe_offset=j * Q6_THREADS
                ]

def f32_gemm_tiled_kernel(
    w: Pointer[Float32, MutAnyOrigin],
    x: Pointer[Float32, MutAnyOrigin],
    y: Pointer[Float32, MutAnyOrigin],
    cols: Int32,
    batch: Int32,
    rows: Int32,
):

    var idx = Int(block_idx.x)
